import Foundation.FirstOrder.Arith.Basic

namespace LO

namespace FirstOrder

variable {L : Language} [L.LT]

namespace Arith

inductive Hierarchy : Polarity → ℕ → {n : ℕ} → Semiformula L ξ n → Prop
  | verum (Γ s n)                                    : Hierarchy Γ s (⊤ : Semiformula L ξ n)
  | falsum (Γ s n)                                   : Hierarchy Γ s (⊥ : Semiformula L ξ n)
  | rel (Γ s) {k} (r : L.Rel k) (v)                  : Hierarchy Γ s (Semiformula.rel r v)
  | nrel (Γ s) {k} (r : L.Rel k) (v)                 : Hierarchy Γ s (Semiformula.nrel r v)
  | and {Γ s n} {φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n}            : Hierarchy Γ s φ → Hierarchy Γ s ψ → Hierarchy Γ s (φ ⋏ ψ)
  | or {Γ s n} {φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n}             : Hierarchy Γ s φ → Hierarchy Γ s ψ → Hierarchy Γ s (φ ⋎ ψ)
  | ball {Γ s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)} {t : Semiterm L ξ (n + 1)} :
    t.Positive → Hierarchy Γ s φ → Hierarchy Γ s (∀[“x. x < !!t”] φ)
  | bex {Γ s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)} {t : Semiterm L ξ (n + 1)} :
    t.Positive → Hierarchy Γ s φ → Hierarchy Γ s (∃[“x. x < !!t”] φ)
  | ex {s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)}           : Hierarchy 𝚺 (s + 1) φ → Hierarchy 𝚺 (s + 1) (∃' φ)
  | all {s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)}          : Hierarchy 𝚷 (s + 1) φ → Hierarchy 𝚷 (s + 1) (∀' φ)
  | sigma {s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)}        : Hierarchy 𝚷 s φ → Hierarchy 𝚺 (s + 1) (∃' φ)
  | pi {s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)}           : Hierarchy 𝚺 s φ → Hierarchy 𝚷 (s + 1) (∀' φ)
  | dummy_sigma {s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)}  : Hierarchy 𝚷 (s + 1) φ → Hierarchy 𝚺 (s + 1 + 1) (∀' φ)
  | dummy_pi {s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)}     : Hierarchy 𝚺 (s + 1) φ → Hierarchy 𝚷 (s + 1 + 1) (∃' φ)

def DeltaZero (φ : Semiformula L ξ n) : Prop := Hierarchy 𝚺 0 φ

attribute [simp] Hierarchy.verum Hierarchy.falsum Hierarchy.rel Hierarchy.nrel

namespace Hierarchy

@[simp] lemma and_iff {φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ s (φ ⋏ ψ) ↔ Hierarchy Γ s φ ∧ Hierarchy Γ s ψ :=
  ⟨by generalize hr : φ ⋏ ψ = r
      intro H
      induction H <;> try simp [LO.ball, LO.bex] at hr
      case and =>
        rcases hr with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
        constructor <;> assumption,
   by rintro ⟨hp, hq⟩; exact Hierarchy.and hp hq⟩

@[simp] lemma or_iff {φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ s (φ ⋎ ψ) ↔ Hierarchy Γ s φ ∧ Hierarchy Γ s ψ :=
  ⟨by generalize hr : φ ⋎ ψ = r
      intro H
      induction H <;> try simp [LO.ball, LO.bex] at hr
      case or =>
        rcases hr with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
        constructor <;> assumption,
      by rintro ⟨hp, hq⟩; exact Hierarchy.or hp hq⟩

@[simp] lemma conj_iff {φ : Fin m → Semiformula L ξ n} :
    Hierarchy Γ s (Matrix.conj φ) ↔ ∀ i, Hierarchy Γ s (φ i) := by
  induction m <;> simp[Matrix.conj, Matrix.vecTail, *]
  · exact ⟨by rintro ⟨hz, hs⟩ i; cases i using Fin.cases <;> simp[*],
           by intro h; exact ⟨h 0, fun _ => h _⟩⟩

lemma zero_eq_alt {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ 0 φ → Hierarchy Γ.alt 0 φ := by
  generalize hz : 0 = z
  rw[eq_comm] at hz
  intro h
  induction h <;> try simp at hz ⊢
  case and _ _ ihp ihq =>
    exact ⟨ihp hz, ihq hz⟩
  case or _ _ ihp ihq => exact ⟨ihp hz, ihq hz⟩
  case ball pos _ ih => exact ball pos (ih hz)
  case bex pos _ ih => exact bex pos (ih hz)

lemma pi_zero_iff_sigma_zero {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy 𝚷 0 φ ↔ Hierarchy 𝚺 0 φ := ⟨zero_eq_alt, zero_eq_alt⟩

lemma zero_iff {Γ Γ'} {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ 0 φ ↔ Hierarchy Γ' 0 φ := by rcases Γ <;> rcases Γ' <;> simp[pi_zero_iff_sigma_zero]

lemma zero_iff_delta_zero {Γ} {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ 0 φ ↔ DeltaZero φ := by
  simp[DeltaZero, pi_zero_iff_sigma_zero]; apply zero_iff

@[simp] lemma alt_zero_iff_zero {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ.alt 0 φ ↔ Hierarchy Γ 0 φ := by rcases Γ <;> simp[pi_zero_iff_sigma_zero]

lemma accum : ∀ {Γ} {s : ℕ} {φ : Semiformula L ξ n}, Hierarchy Γ s φ → ∀ Γ', Hierarchy Γ' (s + 1) φ
  | _, _, _, verum _ _ _,    _ => verum _ _ _
  | _, _, _, falsum _ _ _,   _ => falsum _ _ _
  | _, _, _, rel _ _ r v,    _ => rel _ _ r v
  | _, _, _, nrel _ _ r v,   _ => nrel _ _ r v
  | _, _, _, and hp hq,      _ => and (hp.accum _) (hq.accum _)
  | _, _, _, or hp hq,       _ => or (hp.accum _) (hq.accum _)
  | _, _, _, ball pos hp,    Γ => ball pos (hp.accum _)
  | _, _, _, bex pos hp,     Γ => bex pos (hp.accum _)
  | _, _, _, all hp,         Γ => by
    cases Γ
    · exact hp.dummy_sigma
    · exact (hp.accum 𝚷).all
  | _, _, _, ex hp,          Γ => by
    cases Γ
    · exact (hp.accum 𝚺).ex
    · exact hp.dummy_pi
  | _, _, _, sigma hp,       Γ => by
    cases Γ
    · exact ((hp.accum 𝚺).accum 𝚺).ex
    · exact (hp.accum 𝚺).dummy_pi
  | _, _, _, pi hp,          Γ => by
    cases Γ
    · exact (hp.accum 𝚷).dummy_sigma
    · exact ((hp.accum 𝚷).accum 𝚷).all
  | _, _, _, dummy_sigma hp, Γ => by
    cases Γ
    · exact (hp.accum 𝚷).dummy_sigma
    · exact ((hp.accum 𝚷).accum 𝚷).all
  | _, _, _, dummy_pi hp,    Γ => by
    cases Γ
    · exact ((hp.accum 𝚺).accum 𝚺).ex
    · exact (hp.accum 𝚺).dummy_pi

lemma strict_mono {Γ s} {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} (hp : Hierarchy Γ s φ) (Γ') {s'} (h : s < s') : Hierarchy Γ' s' φ := by
  have : ∀ d, Hierarchy Γ' (s + d + 1) φ := by
    intro d
    induction' d with s ih
    · simpa using hp.accum Γ'
    · simpa only [Nat.add_succ, add_zero] using ih.accum _
  simpa [show s + (s' - s.succ) + 1 = s' from by simpa [Nat.succ_add] using Nat.add_sub_of_le h] using this (s' - s.succ)

lemma mono {Γ} {s s' : ℕ} {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} (hp : Hierarchy Γ s φ) (h : s ≤ s') : Hierarchy Γ s' φ := by
  rcases Nat.lt_or_eq_of_le h with (lt | rfl)
  · exact hp.strict_mono Γ lt
  · assumption

lemma of_zero {b b'} {s : ℕ} {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} (hp : Hierarchy b 0 φ) : Hierarchy b' s φ := by
  rcases Nat.eq_or_lt_of_le (Nat.zero_le s) with (rfl | pos)
  · exact zero_iff.mp hp
  · exact strict_mono hp b' pos

section

variable {L : Language}

@[simp] lemma equal [L.Eq] [L.LT] {t u : Semiterm L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ s “!!t = !!u” := by
  simp[Semiformula.Operator.operator, Matrix.fun_eq_vec₂,
    Semiformula.Operator.Eq.sentence_eq]

@[simp] lemma lt [L.LT] {t u : Semiterm L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ s “!!t < !!u” := by
  simp[Semiformula.Operator.operator, Matrix.fun_eq_vec₂,
    Semiformula.Operator.Eq.sentence_eq, Semiformula.Operator.LT.sentence_eq]

@[simp] lemma le [L.Eq] [L.LT] {t u : Semiterm L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ s “!!t ≤ !!u” := by
  simp[Semiformula.Operator.operator, Matrix.fun_eq_vec₂,
    Semiformula.Operator.Eq.sentence_eq, Semiformula.Operator.LT.sentence_eq,
    Semiformula.Operator.LE.sentence_eq]

end

lemma neg {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ s φ → Hierarchy Γ.alt s (∼φ) := by
  intro h; induction h <;> try simp[*]
  case bex pos _ ih => exact ball pos ih
  case ball pos _ ih => exact bex pos ih
  case ex ih => exact all ih
  case all ih => exact ex ih
  case sigma ih => exact pi ih
  case pi ih => exact sigma ih
  case dummy_pi ih => exact dummy_sigma ih
  case dummy_sigma ih => exact dummy_pi ih

@[simp] lemma neg_iff {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ s (∼φ) ↔ Hierarchy Γ.alt s φ :=
  ⟨fun h => by simpa using neg h, fun h => by simpa using neg h⟩

@[simp] lemma imp_iff {φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ s (φ ➝ ψ) ↔ (Hierarchy Γ.alt s φ ∧ Hierarchy Γ s ψ) := by simp[Semiformula.imp_eq]

@[simp] lemma ball_iff {Γ s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)} {t : Semiterm L ξ (n + 1)} (ht : t.Positive) :
    Hierarchy Γ s (∀[“x. x < !!t”] φ) ↔ Hierarchy Γ s φ :=
  ⟨by generalize hq : (∀[“x. x < !!t”] φ) = ψ
      intro H
      induction H <;> try simp [LO.ball, LO.bex] at hq
      case ball φ t pt hp ih =>
        rcases hq with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
        assumption
      case all hp ih =>
        rcases hq with rfl
        simpa using hp
      case pi s _ _ hp ih =>
        rcases hq with rfl
        exact (show Hierarchy 𝚺 s φ from by simpa using hp).accum _
      case dummy_sigma hp _ =>
        rcases hq with rfl
        simp at hp
        exact hp.accum _,
   by intro hp; exact hp.ball ht⟩

@[simp] lemma bex_iff {Γ s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)} {t : Semiterm L ξ (n + 1)} (ht : t.Positive) :
    Hierarchy Γ s (∃[“x. x < !!t”] φ) ↔ Hierarchy Γ s φ :=
  ⟨by generalize hq : (∃[“x. x < !!t”] φ) = ψ
      intro H
      induction H <;> try simp [LO.ball, LO.bex] at hq
      case bex φ t pt hp ih =>
        rcases hq with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
        assumption
      case ex hp ih =>
        rcases hq with rfl
        simpa using hp
      case sigma s _ _ hp ih =>
        rcases hq with rfl
        exact (show Hierarchy 𝚷 s φ from by simpa using hp).accum _
      case dummy_pi hp _ =>
        rcases hq with rfl
        simp at hp
        exact hp.accum _,
   by intro hp; exact hp.bex ht⟩

@[simp] lemma ballLT_iff {Γ s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)} {t : Semiterm L ξ n} :
    Hierarchy Γ s (φ.ballLT t) ↔ Hierarchy Γ s φ := by simp [Semiformula.ballLT]

@[simp] lemma bexLT_iff {Γ s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)} {t : Semiterm L ξ n} :
    Hierarchy Γ s (φ.bexLT t) ↔ Hierarchy Γ s φ := by simp [Semiformula.bexLT]

@[simp] lemma ballLTSucc_iff [L.Zero] [L.One] [L.Add] {Γ s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)} {t : Semiterm L ξ n} :
    Hierarchy Γ s (φ.ballLTSucc t) ↔ Hierarchy Γ s φ := by simp [Semiformula.ballLTSucc]

@[simp] lemma bexLTSucc_iff [L.Zero] [L.One] [L.Add] {Γ s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)} {t : Semiterm L ξ n} :
    Hierarchy Γ s (φ.bexLTSucc t) ↔ Hierarchy Γ s φ := by simp [Semiformula.bexLTSucc]

lemma pi_of_pi_all {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)} : Hierarchy 𝚷 s (∀' φ) → Hierarchy 𝚷 s φ := by
  generalize hr : ∀' φ = r
  generalize hb : (𝚷 : Polarity) = Γ
  intro H
  cases H <;> try simp [LO.ball, LO.bex] at hr
  case ball => rcases hr with rfl; simpa
  case all => rcases hr with rfl; simpa
  case pi hp => rcases hr with rfl; exact hp.accum _
  case dummy_sigma hp => rcases hr with rfl; exact hp.accum _

@[simp] lemma all_iff {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)} : Hierarchy 𝚷 (s + 1) (∀' φ) ↔ Hierarchy 𝚷 (s + 1) φ :=
  ⟨pi_of_pi_all, all⟩

lemma sigma_of_sigma_ex {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)} : Hierarchy 𝚺 s (∃' φ) → Hierarchy 𝚺 s φ := by
  generalize hr : ∃' φ = r
  generalize hb : (𝚺 : Polarity) = Γ
  intro H
  cases H <;> try simp [LO.ball, LO.bex] at hr
  case bex => rcases hr with rfl; simpa
  case ex => rcases hr with rfl; simpa
  case sigma hp => rcases hr with rfl; exact hp.accum _
  case dummy_pi hp => rcases hr with rfl; exact hp.accum _

@[simp] lemma sigma_iff {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)} : Hierarchy 𝚺 (s + 1) (∃' φ) ↔ Hierarchy 𝚺 (s + 1) φ :=
  ⟨sigma_of_sigma_ex, ex⟩

lemma rew (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {φ : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁} : Hierarchy Γ s φ → Hierarchy Γ s (ω ▹ φ) := by
  intro h; induction h generalizing n₂ <;> try simp [*, Semiformula.rew_rel, Semiformula.rew_nrel]
  case sigma ih => exact (ih _).accum _
  case pi ih => exact (ih _).accum _
  case dummy_pi ih => exact (ih _).dummy_pi
  case dummy_sigma ih => exact (ih _).dummy_sigma

@[simp] lemma rew_iff {ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂} {φ : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁} :
    Hierarchy Γ s (ω ▹ φ) ↔ Hierarchy Γ s φ := by

    case and ihp ihq =>

    case or ihp ihq =>
      rcases eq with ⟨φ₁, rfl, φ₂, rfl, rfl⟩

      rcases eq with ⟨hp, ⟨u, rfl, s, hs, rfl⟩, φ, rfl, rfl⟩
      simpa [show u.Positive from by simpa using pos] using ih rfl
    case bex pos _ ih =>
      simp [Rew.eq_lt_iff] at eq
      rcases eq with ⟨hp, ⟨u, rfl, s, hs, rfl⟩, φ, rfl, rfl⟩

import Foundation.FirstOrder.Arith.Basic

namespace LO

namespace FirstOrder

variable {L : Language} [L.LT]

namespace Arith

inductive Hierarchy : Polarity → ℕ → {n : ℕ} → Semiformula L ξ n → Prop
  | verum (Γ s n)                                    : Hierarchy Γ s (⊤ : Semiformula L ξ n)
  | falsum (Γ s n)                                   : Hierarchy Γ s (⊥ : Semiformula L ξ n)
  | rel (Γ s) {k} (r : L.Rel k) (v)                  : Hierarchy Γ s (Semiformula.rel r v)
  | nrel (Γ s) {k} (r : L.Rel k) (v)                 : Hierarchy Γ s (Semiformula.nrel r v)
  | and {Γ s n} {φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n}            : Hierarchy Γ s φ → Hierarchy Γ s ψ → Hierarchy Γ s (φ ⋏ ψ)
  | or {Γ s n} {φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n}             : Hierarchy Γ s φ → Hierarchy Γ s ψ → Hierarchy Γ s (φ ⋎ ψ)
  | ball {Γ s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)} {t : Semiterm L ξ (n + 1)} :
    t.Positive → Hierarchy Γ s φ → Hierarchy Γ s (∀[“x. x < !!t”] φ)
  | bex {Γ s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)} {t : Semiterm L ξ (n + 1)} :
    t.Positive → Hierarchy Γ s φ → Hierarchy Γ s (∃[“x. x < !!t”] φ)
  | ex {s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)}           : Hierarchy 𝚺 (s + 1) φ → Hierarchy 𝚺 (s + 1) (∃' φ)
  | all {s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)}          : Hierarchy 𝚷 (s + 1) φ → Hierarchy 𝚷 (s + 1) (∀' φ)
  | sigma {s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)}        : Hierarchy 𝚷 s φ → Hierarchy 𝚺 (s + 1) (∃' φ)
  | pi {s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)}           : Hierarchy 𝚺 s φ → Hierarchy 𝚷 (s + 1) (∀' φ)
  | dummy_sigma {s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)}  : Hierarchy 𝚷 (s + 1) φ → Hierarchy 𝚺 (s + 1 + 1) (∀' φ)
  | dummy_pi {s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)}     : Hierarchy 𝚺 (s + 1) φ → Hierarchy 𝚷 (s + 1 + 1) (∃' φ)

def DeltaZero (φ : Semiformula L ξ n) : Prop := Hierarchy 𝚺 0 φ

attribute [simp] Hierarchy.verum Hierarchy.falsum Hierarchy.rel Hierarchy.nrel

namespace Hierarchy

@[simp] lemma and_iff {φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ s (φ ⋏ ψ) ↔ Hierarchy Γ s φ ∧ Hierarchy Γ s ψ :=
  ⟨by generalize hr : φ ⋏ ψ = r
      intro H
      induction H <;> try simp [LO.ball, LO.bex] at hr
      case and =>
        rcases hr with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
        constructor <;> assumption,
   by rintro ⟨hp, hq⟩; exact Hierarchy.and hp hq⟩

@[simp] lemma or_iff {φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ s (φ ⋎ ψ) ↔ Hierarchy Γ s φ ∧ Hierarchy Γ s ψ :=
  ⟨by generalize hr : φ ⋎ ψ = r
      intro H
      induction H <;> try simp [LO.ball, LO.bex] at hr
      case or =>
        rcases hr with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
        constructor <;> assumption,
      by rintro ⟨hp, hq⟩; exact Hierarchy.or hp hq⟩

@[simp] lemma conj_iff {φ : Fin m → Semiformula L ξ n} :
    Hierarchy Γ s (Matrix.conj φ) ↔ ∀ i, Hierarchy Γ s (φ i) := by
  induction m <;> simp[Matrix.conj, Matrix.vecTail, *]
  · exact ⟨by rintro ⟨hz, hs⟩ i; cases i using Fin.cases <;> simp[*],
           by intro h; exact ⟨h 0, fun _ => h _⟩⟩

lemma zero_eq_alt {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ 0 φ → Hierarchy Γ.alt 0 φ := by
  generalize hz : 0 = z
  rw[eq_comm] at hz
  intro h
  induction h <;> try simp at hz ⊢
  case and _ _ ihp ihq =>
    exact ⟨ihp hz, ihq hz⟩
  case or _ _ ihp ihq => exact ⟨ihp hz, ihq hz⟩
  case ball pos _ ih => exact ball pos (ih hz)
  case bex pos _ ih => exact bex pos (ih hz)

lemma pi_zero_iff_sigma_zero {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy 𝚷 0 φ ↔ Hierarchy 𝚺 0 φ := ⟨zero_eq_alt, zero_eq_alt⟩

lemma zero_iff {Γ Γ'} {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ 0 φ ↔ Hierarchy Γ' 0 φ := by rcases Γ <;> rcases Γ' <;> simp[pi_zero_iff_sigma_zero]

lemma zero_iff_delta_zero {Γ} {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ 0 φ ↔ DeltaZero φ := by
  simp[DeltaZero, pi_zero_iff_sigma_zero]; apply zero_iff

@[simp] lemma alt_zero_iff_zero {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ.alt 0 φ ↔ Hierarchy Γ 0 φ := by rcases Γ <;> simp[pi_zero_iff_sigma_zero]

lemma accum : ∀ {Γ} {s : ℕ} {φ : Semiformula L ξ n}, Hierarchy Γ s φ → ∀ Γ', Hierarchy Γ' (s + 1) φ
  | _, _, _, verum _ _ _,    _ => verum _ _ _
  | _, _, _, falsum _ _ _,   _ => falsum _ _ _
  | _, _, _, rel _ _ r v,    _ => rel _ _ r v
  | _, _, _, nrel _ _ r v,   _ => nrel _ _ r v
  | _, _, _, and hp hq,      _ => and (hp.accum _) (hq.accum _)
  | _, _, _, or hp hq,       _ => or (hp.accum _) (hq.accum _)
  | _, _, _, ball pos hp,    Γ => ball pos (hp.accum _)
  | _, _, _, bex pos hp,     Γ => bex pos (hp.accum _)
  | _, _, _, all hp,         Γ => by
    cases Γ
    · exact hp.dummy_sigma
    · exact (hp.accum 𝚷).all
  | _, _, _, ex hp,          Γ => by
    cases Γ
    · exact (hp.accum 𝚺).ex
    · exact hp.dummy_pi
  | _, _, _, sigma hp,       Γ => by
    cases Γ
    · exact ((hp.accum 𝚺).accum 𝚺).ex
    · exact (hp.accum 𝚺).dummy_pi
  | _, _, _, pi hp,          Γ => by
    cases Γ
    · exact (hp.accum 𝚷).dummy_sigma
    · exact ((hp.accum 𝚷).accum 𝚷).all
  | _, _, _, dummy_sigma hp, Γ => by
    cases Γ
    · exact (hp.accum 𝚷).dummy_sigma
    · exact ((hp.accum 𝚷).accum 𝚷).all
  | _, _, _, dummy_pi hp,    Γ => by
    cases Γ
    · exact ((hp.accum 𝚺).accum 𝚺).ex
    · exact (hp.accum 𝚺).dummy_pi

lemma strict_mono {Γ s} {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} (hp : Hierarchy Γ s φ) (Γ') {s'} (h : s < s') : Hierarchy Γ' s' φ := by
  have : ∀ d, Hierarchy Γ' (s + d + 1) φ := by
    intro d
    induction' d with s ih
    · simpa using hp.accum Γ'
    · simpa only [Nat.add_succ, add_zero] using ih.accum _
  simpa [show s + (s' - s.succ) + 1 = s' from by simpa [Nat.succ_add] using Nat.add_sub_of_le h] using this (s' - s.succ)

lemma mono {Γ} {s s' : ℕ} {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} (hp : Hierarchy Γ s φ) (h : s ≤ s') : Hierarchy Γ s' φ := by
  rcases Nat.lt_or_eq_of_le h with (lt | rfl)
  · exact hp.strict_mono Γ lt
  · assumption

lemma of_zero {b b'} {s : ℕ} {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} (hp : Hierarchy b 0 φ) : Hierarchy b' s φ := by
  rcases Nat.eq_or_lt_of_le (Nat.zero_le s) with (rfl | pos)
  · exact zero_iff.mp hp
  · exact strict_mono hp b' pos

@[simp] lemma equal [L.Eq] [L.LT] {t u : Semiterm L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ s “!!t = !!u” := by
  simp[Semiformula.Operator.operator, Matrix.fun_eq_vec₂,
    Semiformula.Operator.Eq.sentence_eq]

@[simp] lemma lt [L.LT] {t u : Semiterm L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ s “!!t < !!u” := by
  simp[Semiformula.Operator.operator, Matrix.fun_eq_vec₂,
    Semiformula.Operator.Eq.sentence_eq, Semiformula.Operator.LT.sentence_eq]

@[simp] lemma le [L.Eq] [L.LT] {t u : Semiterm L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ s “!!t ≤ !!u” := by
  simp[Semiformula.Operator.operator, Matrix.fun_eq_vec₂,
    Semiformula.Operator.Eq.sentence_eq, Semiformula.Operator.LT.sentence_eq,
    Semiformula.Operator.LE.sentence_eq]

lemma neg {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ s φ → Hierarchy Γ.alt s (∼φ) := by
  intro h; induction h <;> try simp[*]
  case bex pos _ ih => exact ball pos ih
  case ball pos _ ih => exact bex pos ih
  case ex ih => exact all ih
  case all ih => exact ex ih
  case sigma ih => exact pi ih
  case pi ih => exact sigma ih
  case dummy_pi ih => exact dummy_sigma ih
  case dummy_sigma ih => exact dummy_pi ih

@[simp] lemma neg_iff {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ s (∼φ) ↔ Hierarchy Γ.alt s φ :=
  ⟨fun h => by simpa using neg h, fun h => by simpa using neg h⟩

@[simp] lemma imp_iff {φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ s (φ ➝ ψ) ↔ (Hierarchy Γ.alt s φ ∧ Hierarchy Γ s ψ) := by simp[Semiformula.imp_eq]

@[simp] lemma ball_iff {Γ s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)} {t : Semiterm L ξ (n + 1)} (ht : t.Positive) :
    Hierarchy Γ s (∀[“x. x < !!t”] φ) ↔ Hierarchy Γ s φ :=
  ⟨by generalize hq : (∀[“x. x < !!t”] φ) = ψ
      intro H
      induction H <;> try simp [LO.ball, LO.bex] at hq
      case ball φ t pt hp ih =>
        rcases hq with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
        assumption
      case all hp ih =>
        rcases hq with rfl
        simpa using hp
      case pi s _ _ hp ih =>
        rcases hq with rfl
        exact (show Hierarchy 𝚺 s φ from by simpa using hp).accum _
      case dummy_sigma hp _ =>
        rcases hq with rfl
        simp at hp
        exact hp.accum _,
   by intro hp; exact hp.ball ht⟩

@[simp] lemma bex_iff {Γ s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)} {t : Semiterm L ξ (n + 1)} (ht : t.Positive) :
    Hierarchy Γ s (∃[“x. x < !!t”] φ) ↔ Hierarchy Γ s φ :=
  ⟨by generalize hq : (∃[“x. x < !!t”] φ) = ψ
      intro H
      induction H <;> try simp [LO.ball, LO.bex] at hq
      case bex φ t pt hp ih =>
        rcases hq with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
        assumption
      case ex hp ih =>
        rcases hq with rfl
        simpa using hp
      case sigma s _ _ hp ih =>
        rcases hq with rfl
        exact (show Hierarchy 𝚷 s φ from by simpa using hp).accum _
      case dummy_pi hp _ =>
        rcases hq with rfl
        simp at hp
        exact hp.accum _,
   by intro hp; exact hp.bex ht⟩

@[simp] lemma ballLT_iff {Γ s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)} {t : Semiterm L ξ n} :
    Hierarchy Γ s (φ.ballLT t) ↔ Hierarchy Γ s φ := by simp [Semiformula.ballLT]

@[simp] lemma bexLT_iff {Γ s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)} {t : Semiterm L ξ n} :
    Hierarchy Γ s (φ.bexLT t) ↔ Hierarchy Γ s φ := by simp [Semiformula.bexLT]

@[simp] lemma ballLTSucc_iff [L.Zero] [L.One] [L.Add] {Γ s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)} {t : Semiterm L ξ n} :
    Hierarchy Γ s (φ.ballLTSucc t) ↔ Hierarchy Γ s φ := by simp [Semiformula.ballLTSucc]

@[simp] lemma bexLTSucc_iff [L.Zero] [L.One] [L.Add] {Γ s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)} {t : Semiterm L ξ n} :
    Hierarchy Γ s (φ.bexLTSucc t) ↔ Hierarchy Γ s φ := by simp [Semiformula.bexLTSucc]

lemma pi_of_pi_all {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)} : Hierarchy 𝚷 s (∀' φ) → Hierarchy 𝚷 s φ := by
  generalize hr : ∀' φ = r
  generalize hb : (𝚷 : Polarity) = Γ
  intro H
  cases H <;> try simp [LO.ball, LO.bex] at hr
  case ball => rcases hr with rfl; simpa
  case all => rcases hr with rfl; simpa
  case pi hp => rcases hr with rfl; exact hp.accum _
  case dummy_sigma hp => rcases hr with rfl; exact hp.accum _

@[simp] lemma all_iff {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)} : Hierarchy 𝚷 (s + 1) (∀' φ) ↔ Hierarchy 𝚷 (s + 1) φ :=
  ⟨pi_of_pi_all, all⟩

lemma sigma_of_sigma_ex {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)} : Hierarchy 𝚺 s (∃' φ) → Hierarchy 𝚺 s φ := by
  generalize hr : ∃' φ = r
  generalize hb : (𝚺 : Polarity) = Γ
  intro H
  cases H <;> try simp [LO.ball, LO.bex] at hr
  case bex => rcases hr with rfl; simpa
  case ex => rcases hr with rfl; simpa
  case sigma hp => rcases hr with rfl; exact hp.accum _
  case dummy_pi hp => rcases hr with rfl; exact hp.accum _

@[simp] lemma sigma_iff {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)} : Hierarchy 𝚺 (s + 1) (∃' φ) ↔ Hierarchy 𝚺 (s + 1) φ :=
  ⟨sigma_of_sigma_ex, ex⟩

lemma rew (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {φ : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁} : Hierarchy Γ s φ → Hierarchy Γ s (ω ▹ φ) := by
  intro h; induction h generalizing n₂ <;> try simp [*, Semiformula.rew_rel, Semiformula.rew_nrel]
  case sigma ih => exact (ih _).accum _
  case pi ih => exact (ih _).accum _
  case dummy_pi ih => exact (ih _).dummy_pi
  case dummy_sigma ih => exact (ih _).dummy_sigma

@[simp] lemma rew_iff {ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂} {φ : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁} :
    Hierarchy Γ s (ω ▹ φ) ↔ Hierarchy Γ s φ := by

  · generalize eq : ω ▹ φ = ψ
    intro hq
    induction hq generalizing φ n₁
      <;> try simp [Semiformula.eq_rel_iff,
        Semiformula.eq_nrel_iff, Semiformula.eq_ball_iff,
        Semiformula.eq_bex_iff, Semiformula.eq_all_iff,
        Semiformula.eq_ex_iff] at eq
    case verum => rcases eq with rfl; simp
    case falsum => rcases eq with rfl; simp
    case rel => rcases eq with ⟨v', rfl, rfl⟩; simp
    case nrel => rcases eq with ⟨v', rfl, rfl⟩; simp
    case and ihp ihq =>
      rcases eq with ⟨φ₁, rfl, φ₂, rfl, rfl⟩
      simpa using ⟨ihp rfl, ihq rfl⟩
    case or ihp ihq =>
      rcases eq with ⟨φ₁, rfl, φ₂, rfl, rfl⟩
      simpa using ⟨ihp rfl, ihq rfl⟩
    case ball pos _ ih =>
      simp [Rew.eq_lt_iff] at eq
      rcases eq with ⟨hp, ⟨u, rfl, s, hs, rfl⟩, φ, rfl, rfl⟩
      simpa [show u.Positive from by simpa using pos] using ih rfl
    case bex pos _ ih =>
      simp [Rew.eq_lt_iff] at eq
      rcases eq with ⟨hp, ⟨u, rfl, s, hs, rfl⟩, φ, rfl, rfl⟩
      simpa [show u.Positive from by simpa using pos] using ih rfl
    case all ih =>
      rcases eq with ⟨φ, rfl, rfl⟩
      exact (ih rfl).all
    case ex ih =>
      rcases eq with ⟨φ, rfl, rfl⟩
      exact (ih rfl).ex
    case pi ih =>
      rcases eq with ⟨φ, rfl, rfl⟩
      exact (ih rfl).pi
    case sigma ih =>
      rcases eq with ⟨φ, rfl, rfl⟩
      exact (ih rfl).sigma
    case dummy_sigma ih =>
      rcases eq with ⟨φ, rfl, rfl⟩
      exact (ih rfl).dummy_sigma
    case dummy_pi ih =>
      rcases eq with ⟨φ, rfl, rfl⟩
      exact (ih rfl).dummy_pi
  · exact rew _

lemma exClosure : {n : ℕ} → {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} → Hierarchy 𝚺 (s + 1) φ → Hierarchy 𝚺 (s + 1) (exClosure φ)
  | 0,     _, hp => hp
  | n + 1, φ, hp => by simpa using exClosure (hp.ex)

  ⟨by generalize hr : φ ⋏ ψ = r
      intro H
      induction H <;> try simp [LO.ball, LO.bex] at hr
      case and =>
        rcases hr with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
        constructor <;> assumption,
   by rintro ⟨hp, hq⟩; exact Hierarchy.and hp hq⟩

lemma zero_eq_alt {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ 0 φ → Hierarchy Γ.alt 0 φ := by
  generalize hz : 0 = z
  rw[eq_comm] at hz
  intro h
  induction h <;> try simp at hz ⊢
  case and _ _ ihp ihq =>
    exact ⟨ihp hz, ihq hz⟩
  case or _ _ ihp ihq => exact ⟨ihp hz, ihq hz⟩
  case ball pos _ ih => exact ball pos (ih hz)
  case bex pos _ ih => exact bex pos (ih hz)

lemma accum : ∀ {Γ} {s : ℕ} {φ : Semiformula L ξ n}, Hierarchy Γ s φ → ∀ Γ', Hierarchy Γ' (s + 1) φ
  | _, _, _, verum _ _ _,    _ => verum _ _ _
  | _, _, _, falsum _ _ _,   _ => falsum _ _ _
  | _, _, _, rel _ _ r v,    _ => rel _ _ r v
  | _, _, _, nrel _ _ r v,   _ => nrel _ _ r v
  | _, _, _, and hp hq,      _ => and (hp.accum _) (hq.accum _)
  | _, _, _, or hp hq,       _ => or (hp.accum _) (hq.accum _)
  | _, _, _, ball pos hp,    Γ => ball pos (hp.accum _)
  | _, _, _, bex pos hp,     Γ => bex pos (hp.accum _)
  | _, _, _, all hp,         Γ => by
    cases Γ
    · exact hp.dummy_sigma
    · exact (hp.accum 𝚷).all
  | _, _, _, ex hp,          Γ => by
    cases Γ
    · exact (hp.accum 𝚺).ex
    · exact hp.dummy_pi
  | _, _, _, sigma hp,       Γ => by
    cases Γ
    · exact ((hp.accum 𝚺).accum 𝚺).ex
    · exact (hp.accum 𝚺).dummy_pi
  | _, _, _, pi hp,          Γ => by
    cases Γ
    · exact (hp.accum 𝚷).dummy_sigma
    · exact ((hp.accum 𝚷).accum 𝚷).all
  | _, _, _, dummy_sigma hp, Γ => by
    cases Γ
    · exact (hp.accum 𝚷).dummy_sigma
    · exact ((hp.accum 𝚷).accum 𝚷).all
  | _, _, _, dummy_pi hp,    Γ => by
    cases Γ
    · exact ((hp.accum 𝚺).accum 𝚺).ex
    · exact (hp.accum 𝚺).dummy_pi

lemma strict_mono {Γ s} {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} (hp : Hierarchy Γ s φ) (Γ') {s'} (h : s < s') : Hierarchy Γ' s' φ := by
  have : ∀ d, Hierarchy Γ' (s + d + 1) φ := by
    intro d
    induction' d with s ih
    · simpa using hp.accum Γ'
    · simpa only [Nat.add_succ, add_zero] using ih.accum _
  simpa [show s + (s' - s.succ) + 1 = s' from by simpa [Nat.succ_add] using Nat.add_sub_of_le h] using this (s' - s.succ)

informal_statement: For any formulas φ and ψ, the property Hierarchy b s (φ ⭤ ψ) holds if and only if Hierarchy b s φ, Hierarchy b.alt s φ, Hierarchy b s ψ, and Hierarchy b.alt s ψ all hold simultaneously.
informal_proof:
To establish the equivalence, we proceed in two directions.

**Forward Direction (⇒):**  
Assume that Hierarchy b s (φ ⭤ ψ) holds. By the definition of Hierarchy (Semiformula.iff_eq), this implies that both φ and ψ individually must satisfy Hierarchy b s and Hierarchy b.alt s under the given parameters. Therefore, φ and ψ each meet all four hierarchy conditions.

**Reverse Direction (⇐):**  
Conversely, suppose that all four conditions hold: Hierarchy b s φ, Hierarchy b.alt s φ, Hierarchy b s ψ, and Hierarchy b.alt s ψ. Then, by the definition of Hierarchy b s (φ ⭤ ψ), the combination φ ⭤ ψ satisfies the hierarchy as well, since both φ and ψ individually meet the required conditions.

Thus, the equivalence is satisfied: Hierarchy b s (φ ⭤ ψ) holds precisely when all four corresponding conditions for φ and ψ hold.

import Foundation.FirstOrder.Arith.Basic

namespace LO

namespace FirstOrder

variable {L : Language} [L.LT]

namespace Arith

inductive Hierarchy : Polarity → ℕ → {n : ℕ} → Semiformula L ξ n → Prop
  | verum (Γ s n)                                    : Hierarchy Γ s (⊤ : Semiformula L ξ n)
  | falsum (Γ s n)                                   : Hierarchy Γ s (⊥ : Semiformula L ξ n)
  | rel (Γ s) {k} (r : L.Rel k) (v)                  : Hierarchy Γ s (Semiformula.rel r v)
  | nrel (Γ s) {k} (r : L.Rel k) (v)                 : Hierarchy Γ s (Semiformula.nrel r v)
  | and {Γ s n} {φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n}            : Hierarchy Γ s φ → Hierarchy Γ s ψ → Hierarchy Γ s (φ ⋏ ψ)
  | or {Γ s n} {φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n}             : Hierarchy Γ s φ → Hierarchy Γ s ψ → Hierarchy Γ s (φ ⋎ ψ)

  | _, _, _, and hp hq,      _ => and (hp.accum _) (hq.accum _)
  | _, _, _, or hp hq,       _ => or (hp.accum _) (hq.accum _)
  | _, _, _, ball pos hp,    Γ => ball pos (hp.accum _)
  | _, _, _, bex pos hp,     Γ => bex pos (hp.accum _)
  | _, _, _, all hp,         Γ => by
    cases Γ
    · exact hp.dummy_sigma
    · exact (hp.accum 𝚷).all
  | _, _, _, ex hp,          Γ => by
    cases Γ
    · exact (hp.accum 𝚺).ex
    · exact hp.dummy_pi

    cases Γ
    · exact ((hp.accum 𝚺).accum 𝚺).ex

    cases Γ
    · exact (hp.accum 𝚷).dummy_sigma

    intro d
    induction' d with s ih
    · simpa using hp.accum Γ'
    · simpa only [Nat.add_succ, add_zero] using ih.accum _
  simpa [show s + (s' - s.succ) + 1 = s' from by simpa [Nat.succ_add] using Nat.add_sub_of_le h] using this (s' - s.succ)

  · exact hp.strict_mono Γ lt
  · assumption

lemma of_zero {b b'} {s : ℕ} {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} (hp : Hierarchy b 0 φ) : Hierarchy b' s φ := by
  rcases Nat.eq_or_lt_of_le (Nat.zero_le s) with (rfl | pos)
  · exact zero_iff.mp hp
  · exact strict_mono hp b' pos

lemma neg {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ s φ → Hierarchy Γ.alt s (∼φ) := by
  intro h; induction h <;> try simp[*]
  case bex pos _ ih => exact ball pos ih
  case ball pos _ ih => exact bex pos ih
  case ex ih => exact all ih
  case all ih => exact ex ih
  case sigma ih => exact pi ih
  case pi ih => exact sigma ih
  case dummy_pi ih => exact dummy_sigma ih
  case dummy_sigma ih => exact dummy_pi ih

@[simp] lemma neg_iff {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ s (∼φ) ↔ Hierarchy Γ.alt s φ :=
  ⟨fun h => by simpa using neg h, fun h => by simpa using neg h⟩

@[simp] lemma ball_iff {Γ s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)} {t : Semiterm L ξ (n + 1)} (ht : t.Positive) :
    Hierarchy Γ s (∀[“x. x < !!t”] φ) ↔ Hierarchy Γ s φ :=
  ⟨by generalize hq : (∀[“x. x < !!t”] φ) = ψ
      intro H
      induction H <;> try simp [LO.ball, LO.bex] at hq
      case ball φ t pt hp ih =>
        rcases hq with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
        assumption
      case all hp ih =>
        rcases hq with rfl
        simpa using hp
      case pi s _ _ hp ih =>
        rcases hq with rfl
        exact (show Hierarchy 𝚺 s φ from by simpa using hp).accum _
      case dummy_sigma hp _ =>
        rcases hq with rfl
        simp at hp
        exact hp.accum _,
   by intro hp; exact hp.ball ht⟩

    Hierarchy Γ s (∃[“x. x < !!t”] φ) ↔ Hierarchy Γ s φ :=
  ⟨by generalize hq : (∃[“x. x < !!t”] φ) = ψ
      intro H
      induction H <;> try simp [LO.ball, LO.bex] at hq
      case bex φ t pt hp ih =>
        rcases hq with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
        assumption
      case ex hp ih =>
        rcases hq with rfl
        simpa using hp
      case sigma s _ _ hp ih =>
        rcases hq with rfl
        exact (show Hierarchy 𝚷 s φ from by simpa using hp).accum _
      case dummy_pi hp _ =>
        rcases hq with rfl
        simp at hp
        exact hp.accum _,

    Hierarchy Γ s (φ.bexLT t) ↔ Hierarchy Γ s φ := by simp [Semiformula.bexLT]

  generalize hr : ∀' φ = r
  generalize hb : (𝚷 : Polarity) = Γ
  intro H
  cases H <;> try simp [LO.ball, LO.bex] at hr
  case ball => rcases hr with rfl; simpa
  case all => rcases hr with rfl; simpa
  case pi hp => rcases hr with rfl; exact hp.accum _
  case dummy_sigma hp => rcases hr with rfl; exact hp.accum _

@[simp] lemma all_iff {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)} : Hierarchy 𝚷 (s + 1) (∀' φ) ↔ Hierarchy 𝚷 (s + 1) φ :=
  ⟨pi_of_pi_all, all⟩

lemma sigma_of_sigma_ex {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)} : Hierarchy 𝚺 s (∃' φ) → Hierarchy 𝚺 s φ := by
  generalize hr : ∃' φ = r
  generalize hb : (𝚺 : Polarity) = Γ
  intro H
  cases H <;> try simp [LO.ball, LO.bex] at hr
  case bex => rcases hr with rfl; simpa
  case ex => rcases hr with rfl; simpa
  case sigma hp => rcases hr with rfl; exact hp.accum _
  case dummy_pi hp => rcases hr with rfl; exact hp.accum _

@[simp] lemma sigma_iff {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)} : Hierarchy 𝚺 (s + 1) (∃' φ) ↔ Hierarchy 𝚺 (s + 1) φ :=
  ⟨sigma_of_sigma_ex, ex⟩

lemma rew (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {φ : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁} : Hierarchy Γ s φ → Hierarchy Γ s (ω ▹ φ) := by
  intro h; induction h generalizing n₂ <;> try simp [*, Semiformula.rew_rel, Semiformula.rew_nrel]
  case sigma ih => exact (ih _).accum _
  case pi ih => exact (ih _).accum _
  case dummy_pi ih => exact (ih _).dummy_pi
  case dummy_sigma ih => exact (ih _).dummy_sigma

@[simp] lemma rew_iff {ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂} {φ : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁} :
    Hierarchy Γ s (ω ▹ φ) ↔ Hierarchy Γ s φ := by
  constructor
  · generalize eq : ω ▹ φ = ψ
    intro hq
    induction hq generalizing φ n₁
      <;> try simp [Semiformula.eq_rel_iff,
        Semiformula.eq_nrel_iff, Semiformula.eq_ball_iff,
        Semiformula.eq_bex_iff, Semiformula.eq_all_iff,
        Semiformula.eq_ex_iff] at eq
    case verum => rcases eq with rfl; simp
    case falsum => rcases eq with rfl; simp
    case rel => rcases eq with ⟨v', rfl, rfl⟩; simp
    case nrel => rcases eq with ⟨v', rfl, rfl⟩; simp
    case and ihp ihq =>
      rcases eq with ⟨φ₁, rfl, φ₂, rfl, rfl⟩
      simpa using ⟨ihp rfl, ihq rfl⟩
    case or ihp ihq =>
      rcases eq with ⟨φ₁, rfl, φ₂, rfl, rfl⟩
      simpa using ⟨ihp rfl, ihq rfl⟩
    case ball pos _ ih =>
      simp [Rew.eq_lt_iff] at eq
      rcases eq with ⟨hp, ⟨u, rfl, s, hs, rfl⟩, φ, rfl, rfl⟩
      simpa [show u.Positive from by simpa using pos] using ih rfl
    case bex pos _ ih =>
      simp [Rew.eq_lt_iff] at eq
      rcases eq with ⟨hp, ⟨u, rfl, s, hs, rfl⟩, φ, rfl, rfl⟩
      simpa [show u.Positive from by simpa using pos] using ih rfl
    case all ih =>
      rcases eq with ⟨φ, rfl, rfl⟩
      exact (ih rfl).all
    case ex ih =>
      rcases eq with ⟨φ, rfl, rfl⟩
      exact (ih rfl).ex
    case pi ih =>
      rcases eq with ⟨φ, rfl, rfl⟩
      exact (ih rfl).pi
    case sigma ih =>
      rcases eq with ⟨φ, rfl, rfl⟩
      exact (ih rfl).sigma
    case dummy_sigma ih =>
      rcases eq with ⟨φ, rfl, rfl⟩
      exact (ih rfl).dummy_sigma
    case dummy_pi ih =>
      rcases eq with ⟨φ, rfl, rfl⟩
      exact (ih rfl).dummy_pi
  · exact rew _

lemma exClosure : {n : ℕ} → {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} → Hierarchy 𝚺 (s + 1) φ → Hierarchy 𝚺 (s + 1) (exClosure φ)
  | 0,     _, hp => hp
  | n + 1, φ, hp => by exact?

lemma strict_mono {Γ s} {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} (hp : Hierarchy Γ s φ) (Γ') {s'} (h : s < s') : Hierarchy Γ' s' φ := by
  have : ∀ d, Hierarchy Γ' (s + d + 1) φ := by
    intro d
    induction' d with s ih
    · simpa using hp.accum Γ'
    · simpa only [Nat.add_succ, add_zero] using ih.accum _
  simpa [show s + (s' - s.succ) + 1 = s' from by simpa [Nat.succ_add] using Nat.add_sub_of_le h] using this (s' - s.succ)

lemma mono {Γ} {s s' : ℕ} {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} (hp : Hierarchy Γ s φ) (h : s ≤ s') : Hierarchy Γ s' φ := by
  rcases Nat.lt_or_eq_of_le h with (lt | rfl)
  · exact hp.strict_mono Γ lt
  · assumption

lemma of_zero {b b'} {s : ℕ} {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} (hp : Hierarchy b 0 φ) : Hierarchy b' s φ := by
  rcases Nat.eq_or_lt_of_le (Nat.zero_le s) with (rfl | pos)
  · exact zero_iff.mp hp
  · exact strict_mono hp b' pos

variable {L : Language}

@[simp] lemma equal [L.Eq] [L.LT] {t u : Semiterm L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ s “!!t = !!u” := by
  simp[Semiformula.Operator.operator, Matrix.fun_eq_vec₂,
    Semiformula.Operator.Eq.sentence_eq]

@[simp] lemma lt [L.LT] {t u : Semiterm L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ s “!!t < !!u” := by
  simp[Semiformula.Operator.operator, Matrix.fun_eq_vec₂,
    Semiformula.Operator.Eq.sentence_eq, Semiformula.Operator.LT.sentence_eq]

@[simp] lemma le [L.Eq] [L.LT] {t u : Semiterm L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ s “!!t ≤ !!u” := by
  simp[Semiformula.Operator.operator, Matrix.fun_eq_vec₂,
    Semiformula.Operator.Eq.sentence_eq, Semiformula.Operator.LT.sentence_eq,
    Semiformula.Operator.LE.sentence_eq]

end

lemma neg {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ s φ → Hierarchy Γ.alt s (∼φ) := by
  intro h; induction h <;> try simp[*]
  case bex pos _ ih => exact ball pos ih
  case ball pos _ ih => exact bex pos ih
  case ex ih => exact all ih
  case all ih => exact ex ih
  case sigma ih => exact pi ih
  case pi ih => exact sigma ih
  case dummy_pi ih => exact dummy_sigma ih
  case dummy_sigma ih => exact dummy_pi ih

@[simp] lemma neg_iff {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ s (∼φ) ↔ Hierarchy Γ.alt s φ :=
  ⟨fun h => by simpa using neg h, fun h => by simpa using neg h⟩

@[simp] lemma imp_iff {φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ s (φ ➝ ψ) ↔ (Hierarchy Γ.alt s φ ∧ Hierarchy Γ s ψ) := by simp[Semiformula.imp_eq]

@[simp] lemma ball_iff {Γ s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)} {t : Semiterm L ξ (n + 1)} (ht : t.Positive) :
    Hierarchy Γ s (∀[“x. x < !!t”] φ) ↔ Hierarchy Γ s φ :=
  ⟨by generalize hq : (∀[“x. x < !!t”] φ) = ψ
      intro H
      induction H <;> try simp [LO.ball, LO.bex] at hq
      case ball φ t pt hp ih =>
        rcases hq with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
        assumption
      case all hp ih =>
        rcases hq with rfl
        simpa using hp
      case pi s _ _ hp ih =>
        rcases hq with rfl
        exact (show Hierarchy 𝚺 s φ from by simpa using hp).accum _
      case dummy_sigma hp _ =>
        rcases hq with rfl
        simp at hp
        exact hp.accum _,
   by intro hp; exact hp.ball ht⟩

@[simp] lemma bex_iff {Γ s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)} {t : Semiterm L ξ (n + 1)} (ht : t.Positive) :
    Hierarchy Γ s (∃[“x. x < !!t”] φ) ↔ Hierarchy Γ s φ :=
  ⟨by generalize hq : (∃[“x. x < !!t”] φ) = ψ
      intro H
      induction H <;> try simp [LO.ball, LO.bex] at hq
      case bex φ t pt hp ih =>
        rcases hq with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
        assumption
      case ex hp ih =>
        rcases hq with rfl
        simpa using hp
      case sigma s _ _ hp ih =>
        rcases hq with rfl
        exact (show Hierarchy 𝚷 s φ from by simpa using hp).accum _
      case dummy_pi hp _ =>
        rcases hq with rfl
        simp at hp
        exact hp.accum _,
   by intro hp; exact hp.bex ht⟩

@[simp] lemma ballLT_iff {Γ s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)} {t : Semiterm L ξ n} :
    Hierarchy Γ s (φ.ballLT t) ↔ Hierarchy Γ s φ := by simp [Semiformula.ballLT]

@[simp] lemma bexLT_iff {Γ s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)} {t : Semiterm L ξ n} :
    Hierarchy Γ s (φ.bexLT t) ↔ Hierarchy Γ s φ := by simp [Semiformula.bexLT]

@[simp] lemma ballLTSucc_iff [L.Zero] [L.One] [L.Add] {Γ s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)} {t : Semiterm L ξ n} :
    Hierarchy Γ s (φ.ballLTSucc t) ↔ Hierarchy Γ s φ := by simp [Semiformula.ballLTSucc]

@[simp] lemma bexLTSucc_iff [L.Zero] [L.One] [L.Add] {Γ s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)} {t : Semiterm L ξ n} :
    Hierarchy Γ s (φ.bexLTSucc t) ↔ Hierarchy Γ s φ := by simp [Semiformula.bexLTSucc]

lemma pi_of_pi_all {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)} : Hierarchy 𝚷 s (∀' φ) → Hierarchy 𝚷 s φ := by
  generalize hr : ∀' φ = r
  generalize hb : (𝚷 : Polarity) = Γ
  intro H
  cases H <;> try simp [LO.ball, LO.bex] at hr
  case ball => rcases hr with rfl; simpa
  case all => rcases hr with rfl; simpa
  case pi hp => rcases hr with rfl; exact hp.accum _
  case dummy_sigma hp => rcases hr with rfl; exact hp.accum _

@[simp] lemma all_iff {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)} : Hierarchy 𝚷 (s + 1) (∀' φ) ↔ Hierarchy 𝚷 (s + 1) φ :=
  ⟨pi_of_pi_all, all⟩

lemma sigma_of_sigma_ex {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)} : Hierarchy 𝚺 s (∃' φ) → Hierarchy 𝚺 s φ := by
  generalize hr : ∃' φ = r
  generalize hb : (𝚺 : Polarity) = Γ
  intro H
  cases H <;> try simp [LO.ball, LO.bex] at hr
  case bex => rcases hr with rfl; simpa
  case ex => rcases hr with rfl; simpa
  case sigma hp => rcases hr with rfl; exact hp.accum _
  case dummy_pi hp => rcases hr with rfl; exact hp.accum _

@[simp] lemma sigma_iff {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)} : Hierarchy 𝚺 (s + 1) (∃' φ) ↔ Hierarchy 𝚺 (s + 1) φ :=
  ⟨sigma_of_sigma_ex, ex⟩

lemma rew (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {φ : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁} : Hierarchy Γ s φ → Hierarchy Γ s (ω ▹ φ) := by
  intro h; induction h generalizing n₂ <;> try simp [*, Semiformula.rew_rel, Semiformula.rew_nrel]
  case sigma ih => exact (ih _).accum _
  case pi ih => exact (ih _).accum _
  case dummy_pi ih => exact (ih _).dummy_pi
  case dummy_sigma ih => exact (ih _).dummy_sigma

@[simp] lemma rew_iff {ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂} {φ : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁} :
    Hierarchy Γ s (ω ▹ φ) ↔ Hierarchy Γ s φ := by
  constructor
  · generalize eq : ω ▹ φ = ψ
    intro hq
    induction hq generalizing φ n₁
      <;> try simp [Semiformula.eq_rel_iff,
        Semiformula.eq_nrel_iff, Semiformula.eq_ball_iff,
        Semiformula.eq_bex_iff, Semiformula.eq_all_iff,
        Semiformula.eq_ex_iff] at eq
    case verum => rcases eq with rfl; simp
    case falsum => rcases eq with rfl; simp
    case rel => rcases eq with ⟨v', rfl, rfl⟩; simp
    case nrel => rcases eq with ⟨v', rfl, rfl⟩; simp
    case and ihp ihq =>
      rcases eq with ⟨φ₁, rfl, φ₂, rfl, rfl⟩
      simpa using ⟨ihp rfl, ihq rfl⟩
    case or ihp ihq =>
      rcases eq with ⟨φ₁, rfl, φ₂, rfl, rfl⟩
      simpa using ⟨ihp rfl, ihq rfl⟩
    case ball pos _ ih =>
      simp [Rew.eq_lt_iff] at eq
      rcases eq with ⟨hp, ⟨u, rfl, s, hs, rfl⟩, φ, rfl, rfl⟩
      simpa [show u.Positive from by simpa using pos] using ih rfl
    case bex pos _ ih =>
      simp [Rew.eq_lt_iff] at eq
      rcases eq with ⟨hp, ⟨u, rfl, s, hs, rfl⟩, φ, rfl, rfl⟩
      simpa [show u.Positive from by simpa using pos] using ih rfl
    case all ih =>
      rcases eq with ⟨φ, rfl, rfl⟩
      exact (ih rfl).all
    case ex ih =>
      rcases eq with ⟨φ, rfl, rfl⟩
      exact (ih rfl).ex
    case pi ih =>
      rcases eq with ⟨φ, rfl, rfl⟩
      exact (ih rfl).pi
    case sigma ih =>
      rcases eq with ⟨φ, rfl, rfl⟩
      exact (ih rfl).sigma
    case dummy_sigma ih =>
      rcases eq with ⟨φ, rfl, rfl⟩
      exact (ih rfl).dummy_sigma
    case dummy_pi ih =>
      rcases eq with ⟨φ, rfl, rfl⟩
      exact (ih rfl).dummy_pi
  · exact rew _

lemma exClosure : {n : ℕ} → {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} → Hierarchy 𝚺 (s + 1) φ → Hierarchy 𝚺 (s + 1) (exClosure φ)
  | 0,     _, hp => hp
  | n + 1, φ, hp => by simpa using exClosure (hp.ex)

lemma accum : ∀ {Γ} {s : ℕ} {φ : Semiformula L ξ n}, Hierarchy Γ s φ → ∀ Γ', Hierarchy Γ' (s + 1) φ
  | _, _, _, verum _ _ _,    _ => verum _ _ _
  | _, _, _, falsum _ _ _,   _ => falsum _ _ _
  | _, _, _, rel _ _ r v,    _ => rel _ _ r v
  | _, _, _, nrel _ _ r v,   _ => nrel _ _ r v
  | _, _, _, and hp hq,      _ => and (hp.accum _) (hq.accum _)
  | _, _, _, or hp hq,       _ => or (hp.accum _) (hq.accum _)
  | _, _, _, ball pos hp,    Γ => ball pos (hp.accum _)
  | _, _, _, bex pos hp,     Γ => bex pos (hp.accum _)
  | _, _, _, all hp,         Γ => by
    cases Γ
    · exact hp.dummy_sigma
    · exact (hp.accum 𝚷).all
  | _, _, _, ex hp,          Γ => by
    cases Γ
    · exact (hp.accum 𝚺).ex
    · exact hp.dummy_pi
  | _, _, _, sigma hp,       Γ => by
    cases Γ
    · exact ((hp.accum 𝚺).accum 𝚺).ex
    · exact (hp.accum 𝚺).dummy_pi
  | _, _, _, pi hp,          Γ => by
    cases Γ
    · exact (hp.accum 𝚷).dummy_sigma
    · exact ((hp.accum 𝚷).accum 𝚷).all
  | _, _, _, dummy_sigma hp, Γ => by
    cases Γ
    · exact (hp.accum 𝚷).dummy_sigma
    · exact ((hp.accum 𝚷).accum 𝚷).all
  | _, _, _, dummy_pi hp,    Γ => by
    cases Γ
    · exact ((hp.accum 𝚺).accum 𝚺).ex
    · exact (hp.accum 𝚺).dummy_pi

lemma strict_mono {Γ s} {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} (hp : Hierarchy Γ s φ) (Γ') {s'} (h : s < s') : Hierarchy Γ' s' φ := by
  have : ∀ d, Hierarchy Γ' (s + d + 1) φ := by
    intro d
    induction' d with s ih
    · simpa using hp.accum Γ'
    · simpa only [Nat.add_succ, add_zero] using ih.accum _
  simpa [show s + (s' - s.succ) + 1 = s' from by simpa [Nat.succ_add] using Nat.add_sub_of_le h] using this (s' - s.succ)

    Hierarchy Γ s (ω ▹ φ) ↔ Hierarchy Γ s φ := by
  constructor
  · generalize eq : ω ▹ φ = ψ
    intro hq
    induction hq generalizing φ n₁
      <;> try simp [Semiformula.eq_rel_iff,
        Semiformula.eq_nrel_iff, Semiformula.eq_ball_iff,
        Semiformula.eq_bex_iff, Semiformula.eq_all_iff,
        Semiformula.eq_ex_iff] at eq
    case verum => rcases eq with rfl; simp
    case falsum => rcases eq with rfl; simp
    case rel => rcases eq with ⟨v', rfl, rfl⟩; simp
    case nrel => rcases eq with ⟨v', rfl, rfl⟩; simp
    case and ihp ihq =>
      rcases eq with ⟨φ₁, rfl, φ₂, rfl, rfl⟩
      simpa using ⟨ihp rfl, ihq rfl⟩
    case or ihp ihq =>
      rcases eq with ⟨φ₁, rfl, φ₂, rfl, rfl⟩
      simpa using ⟨ihp rfl, ihq rfl⟩
    case ball pos _ ih =>
      simp [Rew.eq_lt_iff] at eq
      rcases eq with ⟨hp, ⟨u, rfl, s, hs, rfl⟩, φ, rfl, rfl⟩
      simpa [show u.Positive from by simpa using pos] using ih rfl
    case bex pos _ ih =>
      simp [Rew.eq_lt_iff] at eq
      rcases eq with ⟨hp, ⟨u, rfl, s, hs, rfl⟩, φ, rfl, rfl⟩
      simpa [show u.Positive from by simpa using pos] using ih rfl
    case all ih =>
      rcases eq with ⟨φ, rfl, rfl⟩
      exact (ih rfl).all
    case ex ih =>
      rcases eq with ⟨φ, rfl, rfl⟩
      exact (ih rfl).ex
    case pi ih =>
      rcases eq with ⟨φ, rfl, rfl⟩
      exact (ih rfl).pi
    case sigma ih =>

      exact (ih rfl).sigma
    case dummy_sigma ih =>
      rcases eq with ⟨φ, rfl, rfl⟩
      exact (ih rfl).dummy_sigma
    case dummy_pi ih =>
      rcases eq with ⟨φ, rfl, rfl⟩
      exact (ih rfl).dummy_pi
  · exact rew _

informal_statement: If a certain property holds for a formula φ in the context of a Hierarchy Γ at level s, then this property also holds for the formula obtained by applying the `lMap` followed by `oringEmb`.
informal_proof:
To establish the statement, we consider the definition of the Hierarchy Γ relating to the Semiformula φ. The property in question is preserved under the transformation `lMap` combined with `oringEmb`. The proof proceeds by induction on the structure of φ, considering each possible form of φ.

- **Case 1: Dependent Pair (Sigma Type)**  
  If φ is a dependent pair type, then applying `lMap` with `oringEmb` to φ preserves the structure of the pair, ensuring that if the property holds for φ, it holds for the transformed pair.

- **Case 2: Dependent Function (Pi Type)**  
  For dependent function types, the transformation maintains the properties required by the Hierarchy, ensuring the transformed function retains the necessary characteristics.

- **Case 3: Unit**  
  The simplest case, where φ is a unit type, trivially satisfies the property as it has no dependencies.

- **Case 4: Product Type**  
  For product types, the transformation ensures that both components of the product respect the Hierarchy property.

In each case, the inductive step applies the properties of `lMap` and `oringEmb`, demonstrating that the transformed formula maintains the Hierarchy property.

import Foundation.FirstOrder.Arith.Basic

namespace LO

namespace FirstOrder

variable {L : Language} [L.LT]

namespace Arith

inductive Hierarchy : Polarity → ℕ → {n : ℕ} → Semiformula L ξ n → Prop
  | verum (Γ s n)                                    : Hierarchy Γ s (⊤ : Semiformula L ξ n)
  | falsum (Γ s n)                                   : Hierarchy Γ s (⊥ : Semiformula L ξ n)
  | rel (Γ s) {k} (r : L.Rel k) (v)                  : Hierarchy Γ s (Semiformula.rel r v)
  | nrel (Γ s) {k} (r : L.Rel k) (v)                 : Hierarchy Γ s (Semiformula.nrel r v)
  | and {Γ s n} {φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n}            : Hierarchy Γ s φ → Hierarchy Γ s ψ → Hierarchy Γ s (φ ⋏ ψ)
  | or {Γ s n} {φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n}             : Hierarchy Γ s φ → Hierarchy Γ s ψ → Hierarchy Γ s (φ ⋎ ψ)
  | ball {Γ s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)} {t : Semiterm L ξ (n + 1)} :
    t.Positive → Hierarchy Γ s φ → Hierarchy Γ s (∀[“x. x < !!t”] φ)
  | bex {Γ s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)} {t : Semiterm L ξ (n + 1)} :
    t.Positive → Hierarchy Γ s φ → Hierarchy Γ s (∃[“x. x < !!t”] φ)
  | ex {s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)}           : Hierarchy 𝚺 (s + 1) φ → Hierarchy 𝚺 (s + 1) (∃' φ)
  | all {s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)}          : Hierarchy 𝚷 (s + 1) φ → Hierarchy 𝚷 (s + 1) (∀' φ)
  | sigma {s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)}        : Hierarchy 𝚷 s φ → Hierarchy 𝚺 (s + 1) (∃' φ)
  | pi {s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)}           : Hierarchy 𝚺 s φ → Hierarchy 𝚷 (s + 1) (∀' φ)
  | dummy_sigma {s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)}  : Hierarchy 𝚷 (s + 1) φ → Hierarchy 𝚺 (s + 1 + 1) (∀' φ)
  | dummy_pi {s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)}     : Hierarchy 𝚺 (s + 1) φ → Hierarchy 𝚷 (s + 1 + 1) (∃' φ)

def DeltaZero (φ : Semiformula L ξ n) : Prop := Hierarchy 𝚺 0 φ

attribute [simp] Hierarchy.verum Hierarchy.falsum Hierarchy.rel Hierarchy.nrel

namespace Hierarchy

@[simp] lemma and_iff {φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ s (φ ⋏ ψ) ↔ Hierarchy Γ s φ ∧ Hierarchy Γ s ψ :=
  ⟨by generalize hr : φ ⋏ ψ = r
      intro H
      induction H <;> try simp [LO.ball, LO.bex] at hr
      case and =>
        rcases hr with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
        constructor <;> assumption,
   by rintro ⟨hp, hq⟩; exact Hierarchy.and hp hq⟩

@[simp] lemma or_iff {φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ s (φ ⋎ ψ) ↔ Hierarchy Γ s φ ∧ Hierarchy Γ s ψ :=
  ⟨by generalize hr : φ ⋎ ψ = r
      intro H
      induction H <;> try simp [LO.ball, LO.bex] at hr
      case or =>
        rcases hr with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
        constructor <;> assumption,
      by rintro ⟨hp, hq⟩; exact Hierarchy.or hp hq⟩

@[simp] lemma conj_iff {φ : Fin m → Semiformula L ξ n} :
    Hierarchy Γ s (Matrix.conj φ) ↔ ∀ i, Hierarchy Γ s (φ i) := by
  induction m <;> simp[Matrix.conj, Matrix.vecTail, *]
  · exact ⟨by rintro ⟨hz, hs⟩ i; cases i using Fin.cases <;> simp[*],
           by intro h; exact ⟨h 0, fun _ => h _⟩⟩

lemma zero_eq_alt {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ 0 φ → Hierarchy Γ.alt 0 φ := by
  generalize hz : 0 = z
  rw[eq_comm] at hz
  intro h
  induction h <;> try simp at hz ⊢
  case and _ _ ihp ihq =>
    exact ⟨ihp hz, ihq hz⟩
  case or _ _ ihp ihq => exact ⟨ihp hz, ihq hz⟩
  case ball pos _ ih => exact ball pos (ih hz)
  case bex pos _ ih => exact bex pos (ih hz)

lemma pi_zero_iff_sigma_zero {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy 𝚷 0 φ ↔ Hierarchy 𝚺 0 φ := ⟨zero_eq_alt, zero_eq_alt⟩

lemma zero_iff {Γ Γ'} {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ 0 φ ↔ Hierarchy Γ' 0 φ := by rcases Γ <;> rcases Γ' <;> simp[pi_zero_iff_sigma_zero]

lemma zero_iff_delta_zero {Γ} {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ 0 φ ↔ DeltaZero φ := by
  simp[DeltaZero, pi_zero_iff_sigma_zero]; apply zero_iff

@[simp] lemma alt_zero_iff_zero {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ.alt 0 φ ↔ Hierarchy Γ 0 φ := by rcases Γ <;> simp[pi_zero_iff_sigma_zero]

lemma accum : ∀ {Γ} {s : ℕ} {φ : Semiformula L ξ n}, Hierarchy Γ s φ → ∀ Γ', Hierarchy Γ' (s + 1) φ
  | _, _, _, verum _ _ _,    _ => verum _ _ _
  | _, _, _, falsum _ _ _,   _ => falsum _ _ _
  | _, _, _, rel _ _ r v,    _ => rel _ _ r v
  | _, _, _, nrel _ _ r v,   _ => nrel _ _ r v
  | _, _, _, and hp hq,      _ => and (hp.accum _) (hq.accum _)
  | _, _, _, or hp hq,       _ => or (hp.accum _) (hq.accum _)
  | _, _, _, ball pos hp,    Γ => ball pos (hp.accum _)
  | _, _, _, bex pos hp,     Γ => bex pos (hp.accum _)
  | _, _, _, all hp,         Γ => by
    cases Γ
    · exact hp.dummy_sigma
    · exact (hp.accum 𝚷).all
  | _, _, _, ex hp,          Γ => by
    cases Γ
    · exact (hp.accum 𝚺).ex

  | falsum (Γ s n)                                   : Hierarchy Γ s (⊥ : Semiformula L ξ n)

  | nrel (Γ s) {k} (r : L.Rel k) (v)                 : Hierarchy Γ s (Semiformula.nrel r v)
  | and {Γ s n} {φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n}            : Hierarchy Γ s φ → Hierarchy Γ s ψ → Hierarchy Γ s (φ ⋏ ψ)
  | or {Γ s n} {φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n}             : Hierarchy Γ s φ → Hierarchy Γ s ψ → Hierarchy Γ s (φ ⋎ ψ)

    t.Positive → Hierarchy Γ s φ → Hierarchy Γ s (∀[“x. x < !!t”] φ)

  | pi {s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)}           : Hierarchy 𝚺 s φ → Hierarchy 𝚷 (s + 1) (∀' φ)
  | dummy_sigma {s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)}  : Hierarchy 𝚷 (s + 1) φ → Hierarchy 𝚺 (s + 1 + 1) (∀' φ)
  | dummy_pi {s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)}     : Hierarchy 𝚺 (s + 1) φ → Hierarchy 𝚷 (s + 1 + 1) (∃' φ)

C1_dependencies.name: rfl
C1_dependencies.content:
/--
`rfl : a = a` is the unique constructor of the equality type. This is the
same as `Eq.refl` except that it takes `a` implicitly instead of explicitly.

This is a more powerful theorem than it may appear at first, because although
the statement of the theorem is `a = a`, Lean will allow anything that is
definitionally equal to that type. So, for instance, `2 + 2 = 4` is proven in
Lean by `rfl`, because both sides are the same up to definitional equality.
-/
@[match_pattern] def rfl {α : Sort u} {a : α} : Eq a a := Eq.refl a

inductive Hierarchy : Polarity → ℕ → {n : ℕ} → Semiformula L ξ n → Prop
  | verum (Γ s n)                                    : Hierarchy Γ s (⊤ : Semiformula L ξ n)
  | falsum (Γ s n)                                   : Hierarchy Γ s (⊥ : Semiformula L ξ n)
  | rel (Γ s) {k} (r : L.Rel k) (v)                  : Hierarchy Γ s (Semiformula.rel r v)
  | nrel (Γ s) {k} (r : L.Rel k) (v)                 : Hierarchy Γ s (Semiformula.nrel r v)
  | and {Γ s n} {φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n}            : Hierarchy Γ s φ → Hierarchy Γ s ψ → Hierarchy Γ s (φ ⋏ ψ)
  | or {Γ s n} {φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n}             : Hierarchy Γ s φ → Hierarchy Γ s ψ → Hierarchy Γ s (φ ⋎ ψ)
  | ball {Γ s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)} {t : Semiterm L ξ (n + 1)} :
    t.Positive → Hierarchy Γ s φ → Hierarchy Γ s (∀[“x. x < !!t”] φ)
  | bex {Γ s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)} {t : Semiterm L ξ (n + 1)} :
    t.Positive → Hierarchy Γ s φ → Hierarchy Γ s (∃[“x. x < !!t”] φ)
  | ex {s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)}           : Hierarchy 𝚺 (s + 1) φ → Hierarchy 𝚺 (s + 1) (∃' φ)
  | all {s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)}          : Hierarchy 𝚷 (s + 1) φ → Hierarchy 𝚷 (s + 1) (∀' φ)
  | sigma {s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)}        : Hierarchy 𝚷 s φ → Hierarchy 𝚺 (s + 1) (∃' φ)

@[simp] lemma and_iff {φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ s (φ ⋏ ψ) ↔ Hierarchy Γ s φ ∧ Hierarchy Γ s ψ :=
  ⟨by generalize hr : φ ⋏ ψ = r
      intro H
      induction H <;> try simp [LO.ball, LO.bex] at hr
      case and =>
        rcases hr with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
        constructor <;> assumption,
   by rintro ⟨hp, hq⟩; exact Hierarchy.and hp hq⟩

lemma zero_eq_alt {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ 0 φ → Hierarchy Γ.alt 0 φ := by
  generalize hz : 0 = z
  rw[eq_comm] at hz
  intro h
  induction h <;> try simp at hz ⊢
  case and _ _ ihp ihq =>
    exact ⟨ihp hz, ihq hz⟩
  case or _ _ ihp ihq => exact ⟨ihp hz, ihq hz⟩
  case ball pos _ ih => exact ball pos (ih hz)
  case bex pos _ ih => exact bex pos (ih hz)

lemma accum : ∀ {Γ} {s : ℕ} {φ : Semiformula L ξ n}, Hierarchy Γ s φ → ∀ Γ', Hierarchy Γ' (s + 1) φ
  | _, _, _, verum _ _ _,    _ => verum _ _ _
  | _, _, _, falsum _ _ _,   _ => falsum _ _ _
  | _, _, _, rel _ _ r v,    _ => rel _ _ r v
  | _, _, _, nrel _ _ r v,   _ => nrel _ _ r v
  | _, _, _, and hp hq,      _ => and (hp.accum _) (hq.accum _)
  | _, _, _, or hp hq,       _ => or (hp.accum _) (hq.accum _)
  | _, _, _, ball pos hp,    Γ => ball pos (hp.accum _)
  | _, _, _, bex pos hp,     Γ => bex pos (hp.accum _)
  | _, _, _, all hp,         Γ => by
    cases Γ
    · exact hp.dummy_sigma
    · exact (hp.accum 𝚷).all
  | _, _, _, ex hp,          Γ => by
    cases Γ
    · exact (hp.accum 𝚺).ex
    · exact hp.dummy_pi
  | _, _, _, sigma hp,       Γ => by
    cases Γ
    · exact ((hp.accum 𝚺).accum 𝚺).ex
    · exact (hp.accum 𝚺).dummy_pi
  | _, _, _, pi hp,          Γ => by
    cases Γ
    · exact (hp.accum 𝚷).dummy_sigma
    · exact ((hp.accum 𝚷).accum 𝚷).all
  | _, _, _, dummy_sigma hp, Γ => by
    cases Γ
    · exact (hp.accum 𝚷).dummy_sigma
    · exact ((hp.accum 𝚷).accum 𝚷).all
  | _, _, _, dummy_pi hp,    Γ => by
    cases Γ
    · exact ((hp.accum 𝚺).accum 𝚺).ex
    · exact (hp.accum 𝚺).dummy_pi

lemma strict_mono {Γ s} {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} (hp : Hierarchy Γ s φ) (Γ') {s'} (h : s < s') : Hierarchy Γ' s' φ := by
  have : ∀ d, Hierarchy Γ' (s + d + 1) φ := by
    intro d
    induction' d with s ih
    · simpa using hp.accum Γ'
    · simpa only [Nat.add_succ, add_zero] using ih.accum _
  simpa [show s + (s' - s.succ) + 1 = s' from by simpa [Nat.succ_add] using Nat.add_sub_of_le h] using this (s' - s.succ)

informal_statement: If a formula \( \varphi \) is of type Open, then it belongs to the hierarchy \( \Gamma \) with context \( s \) and formula \( \varphi \).
informal_proof:
We will prove this statement using mathematical induction on the structure of \( \varphi \).

First, consider the base case where \( \varphi \) is a basic or atomic formula. In this case, since \( \varphi \) is of type Open, by definition, it is straightforwardly part of the hierarchy \( \Gamma \) with context \( s \).

Next, we handle the inductive step. Assuming the statement holds for simpler formulas, we examine how more complex formulas are constructed:

1. **Conjunction (\( \land \))**: If \( \varphi \) is a conjunction of two formulas \( \varphi_1 \) and \( \varphi_2 \), then by the induction hypothesis, both \( \varphi_1 \) and \( \varphi_2 \) are in the hierarchy \( \Gamma \) with context \( s \). The properties of the hierarchy \( \Gamma \) ensure that the conjunction \( \varphi = \varphi_1 \land \varphi_2 \) is also in the hierarchy.

2. **Disjunction (\( \lor \))**: Similarly, if \( \varphi \) is a disjunction of two formulas \( \varphi_1 \) and \( \varphi_2 \), then by the induction hypothesis, both \( \varphi_1 \) and \( \varphi_2 \) are in the hierarchy \( \Gamma \) with context \( s \). The hierarchy properties then include the disjunction \( \varphi = \varphi_1 \lor \varphi_2 \) in \( \Gamma \).

By these inductive steps, we establish that any formula \( \varphi \) that is of type Open must belong to the hierarchy \( \Gamma \) with context \( s \) and formula \( \varphi \).

import Foundation.FirstOrder.Arith.Basic

namespace LO

namespace FirstOrder

variable {L : Language} [L.LT]

namespace Arith

inductive Hierarchy : Polarity → ℕ → {n : ℕ} → Semiformula L ξ n → Prop
  | verum (Γ s n)                                    : Hierarchy Γ s (⊤ : Semiformula L ξ n)
  | falsum (Γ s n)                                   : Hierarchy Γ s (⊥ : Semiformula L ξ n)
  | rel (Γ s) {k} (r : L.Rel k) (v)                  : Hierarchy Γ s (Semiformula.rel r v)
  | nrel (Γ s) {k} (r : L.Rel k) (v)                 : Hierarchy Γ s (Semiformula.nrel r v)
  | and {Γ s n} {φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n}            : Hierarchy Γ s φ → Hierarchy Γ s ψ → Hierarchy Γ s (φ ⋏ ψ)
  | or {Γ s n} {φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n}             : Hierarchy Γ s φ → Hierarchy Γ s ψ → Hierarchy Γ s (φ ⋎ ψ)
  | ball {Γ s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)} {t : Semiterm L ξ (n + 1)} :
    t.Positive → Hierarchy Γ s φ → Hierarchy Γ s (∀[“x. x < !!t”] φ)
  | bex {Γ s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)} {t : Semiterm L ξ (n + 1)} :
    t.Positive → Hierarchy Γ s φ → Hierarchy Γ s (∃[“x. x < !!t”] φ)
  | ex {s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)}           : Hierarchy 𝚺 (s + 1) φ → Hierarchy 𝚺 (s + 1) (∃' φ)
  | all {s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)}          : Hierarchy 𝚷 (s + 1) φ → Hierarchy 𝚷 (s + 1) (∀' φ)
  | sigma {s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)}        : Hierarchy 𝚷 s φ → Hierarchy 𝚺 (s + 1) (∃' φ)
  | pi {s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)}           : Hierarchy 𝚺 s φ → Hierarchy 𝚷 (s + 1) (∀' φ)
  | dummy_sigma {s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)}  : Hierarchy 𝚷 (s + 1) φ → Hierarchy 𝚺 (s + 1 + 1) (∀' φ)
  | dummy_pi {s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)}     : Hierarchy 𝚺 (s + 1) φ → Hierarchy 𝚷 (s + 1 + 1) (∃' φ)

def DeltaZero (φ : Semiformula L ξ n) : Prop := Hierarchy 𝚺 0 φ

attribute [simp] Hierarchy.verum Hierarchy.falsum Hierarchy.rel Hierarchy.nrel

namespace Hierarchy

@[simp] lemma and_iff {φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ s (φ ⋏ ψ) ↔ Hierarchy Γ s φ ∧ Hierarchy Γ s ψ :=
  ⟨by generalize hr : φ ⋏ ψ = r
      intro H
      induction H <;> try simp [LO.ball, LO.bex] at hr
      case and =>
        rcases hr with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
        constructor <;> assumption,
   by rintro ⟨hp, hq⟩; exact Hierarchy.and hp hq⟩

@[simp] lemma or_iff {φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ s (φ ⋎ ψ) ↔ Hierarchy Γ s φ ∧ Hierarchy Γ s ψ :=
  ⟨by generalize hr : φ ⋎ ψ = r
      intro H
      induction H <;> try simp [LO.ball, LO.bex] at hr
      case or =>
        rcases hr with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
        constructor <;> assumption,
      by rintro ⟨hp, hq⟩; exact Hierarchy.or hp hq⟩

@[simp] lemma conj_iff {φ : Fin m → Semiformula L ξ n} :
    Hierarchy Γ s (Matrix.conj φ) ↔ ∀ i, Hierarchy Γ s (φ i) := by
  induction m <;> simp[Matrix.conj, Matrix.vecTail, *]
  · exact ⟨by rintro ⟨hz, hs⟩ i; cases i using Fin.cases <;> simp[*],
           by intro h; exact ⟨h 0, fun _ => h _⟩⟩

lemma zero_eq_alt {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ 0 φ → Hierarchy Γ.alt 0 φ := by
  generalize hz : 0 = z
  rw[eq_comm] at hz
  intro h
  induction h <;> try simp at hz ⊢
  case and _ _ ihp ihq =>
    exact ⟨ihp hz, ihq hz⟩
  case or _ _ ihp ihq => exact ⟨ihp hz, ihq hz⟩
  case ball pos _ ih => exact ball pos (ih hz)
  case bex pos _ ih => exact bex pos (ih hz)

lemma pi_zero_iff_sigma_zero {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy 𝚷 0 φ ↔ Hierarchy 𝚺 0 φ := ⟨zero_eq_alt, zero_eq_alt⟩

C0_dependencies.name: LO.FirstOrder.Arith.Hierarchy.and_iff
C0_dependencies.content:
@[simp] lemma and_iff {φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ s (φ ⋏ ψ) ↔ Hierarchy Γ s φ ∧ Hierarchy Γ s ψ :=
  ⟨by generalize hr : φ ⋏ ψ = r
      intro H
      induction H <;> try simp [LO.ball, LO.bex] at hr
      case and =>
        rcases hr with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
        constructor <;> assumption,
   by rintro ⟨hp, hq⟩; exact Hierarchy.and hp hq⟩

C0_dependencies.name: LO.FirstOrder.Arith.Hierarchy.conj_iff
C0_dependencies.content:
@[simp] lemma conj_iff {φ : Fin m → Semiformula L ξ n} :
    Hierarchy Γ s (Matrix.conj φ) ↔ ∀ i, Hierarchy Γ s (φ i) := by
  induction m <;> simp[Matrix.conj, Matrix.vecTail, *]
  · exact ⟨by rintro ⟨hz, hs⟩ i; cases i using Fin.cases <;> simp[*],
           by intro h; exact ⟨h 0, fun _ => h _⟩⟩

lemma accum : ∀ {Γ} {s : ℕ} {φ : Semiformula L ξ n}, Hierarchy Γ s φ → ∀ Γ', Hierarchy Γ' (s + 1) φ
  | _, _, _, verum _ _ _,    _ => verum _ _ _
  | _, _, _, falsum _ _ _,   _ => falsum _ _ _
  | _, _, _, rel _ _ r v,    _ => rel _ _ r v
  | _, _, _, nrel _ _ r v,   _ => nrel _ _ r v
  | _, _, _, and hp hq,      _ => and (hp.accum _) (hq.accum _)
  | _, _, _, or hp hq,       _ => or (hp.accum _) (hq.accum _)
  | _, _, _, ball pos hp,    Γ => ball pos (hp.accum _)
  | _, _, _, bex pos hp,     Γ => bex pos (hp.accum _)
  | _, _, _, all hp,         Γ => by
    cases Γ
    · exact hp.dummy_sigma
    · exact (hp.accum 𝚷).all
  | _, _, _, ex hp,          Γ => by
    cases Γ
    · exact (hp.accum 𝚺).ex
    · exact hp.dummy_pi
  | _, _, _, sigma hp,       Γ => by
    cases Γ
    · exact ((hp.accum 𝚺).accum 𝚺).ex
    · exact (hp.accum 𝚺).dummy_pi
  | _, _, _, pi hp,          Γ => by
    cases Γ
    · exact (hp.accum 𝚷).dummy_sigma
    · exact ((hp.accum 𝚷).accum 𝚷).all
  | _, _, _, dummy_sigma hp, Γ => by
    cases Γ
    · exact (hp.accum 𝚷).dummy_sigma
    · exact ((hp.accum 𝚷).accum 𝚷).all
  | _, _, _, dummy_pi hp,    Γ => by
    cases Γ
    · exact ((hp.accum 𝚺).accum 𝚺).ex
    · exact (hp.accum 𝚺).dummy_pi

lemma strict_mono {Γ s} {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} (hp : Hierarchy Γ s φ) (Γ') {s'} (h : s < s') : Hierarchy Γ' s' φ := by
  have : ∀ d, Hierarchy Γ' (s + d + 1) φ := by
    intro d
    induction' d with s ih
    · simpa using hp.accum Γ'
    · simpa only [Nat.add_succ, add_zero] using ih.accum _
  simpa [show s + (s' - s.succ) + 1 = s' from by simpa [Nat.succ_add] using Nat.add_sub_of_le h] using this (s' - s.succ)

informal_statement: For any natural number $n$ and any $\text{Semiformula}$ $\phi$, if $\phi$ satisfies the $\text{Hierarchy}$ $\��$ at level $s$, then it also satisfies $\text{Hierarchy}$ $\��$ at level $s + 1$.
informal_proof:
We prove this statement by induction on the natural numbers.

**Base Case ($n = 0$):**

When $n = 0$, the property holds by the definition of `exClosure`, as it is given.

**Inductive Step:**

Assume that for some $n = k$, the statement holds: if $\phi$ satisfies $\text{Hierarchy}$ $\��$ at level $k$, then it satisfies $\text{Hierarchy}$ $\��$ at level $k + 1$.

Now, consider $n = k + 1$. By the inductive hypothesis, since $\phi$ satisfies $\text{Hierarchy}$ $\��$ at level $k$, it must also satisfy $\text{Hierarchy}$ $\��$ at level $(k + 1) + 1 = k + 2$.

This completes the induction, proving that $\phi$ satisfies $\text{Hierarchy}$ $\��$ at all levels $s + 1$.

import Foundation.FirstOrder.Arith.Basic

namespace LO

namespace FirstOrder

variable {L : Language} [L.LT]

namespace Arith

inductive Hierarchy : Polarity → ℕ → {n : ℕ} → Semiformula L ξ n → Prop
  | verum (Γ s n)                                    : Hierarchy Γ s (⊤ : Semiformula L ξ n)
  | falsum (Γ s n)                                   : Hierarchy Γ s (⊥ : Semiformula L ξ n)
  | rel (Γ s) {k} (r : L.Rel k) (v)                  : Hierarchy Γ s (Semiformula.rel r v)
  | nrel (Γ s) {k} (r : L.Rel k) (v)                 : Hierarchy Γ s (Semiformula.nrel r v)
  | and {Γ s n} {φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n}            : Hierarchy Γ s φ → Hierarchy Γ s ψ → Hierarchy Γ s (φ ⋏ ψ)
  | or {Γ s n} {φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n}             : Hierarchy Γ s φ → Hierarchy Γ s ψ → Hierarchy Γ s (φ ⋎ ψ)
  | ball {Γ s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)} {t : Semiterm L ξ (n + 1)} :
    t.Positive → Hierarchy Γ s φ → Hierarchy Γ s (∀[“x. x < !!t”] φ)
  | bex {Γ s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)} {t : Semiterm L ξ (n + 1)} :
    t.Positive → Hierarchy Γ s φ → Hierarchy Γ s (∃[“x. x < !!t”] φ)
  | ex {s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)}           : Hierarchy 𝚺 (s + 1) φ → Hierarchy 𝚺 (s + 1) (∃' φ)
  | all {s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)}          : Hierarchy 𝚷 (s + 1) φ → Hierarchy 𝚷 (s + 1) (∀' φ)
  | sigma {s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)}        : Hierarchy 𝚷 s φ → Hierarchy 𝚺 (s + 1) (∃' φ)
  | pi {s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)}           : Hierarchy 𝚺 s φ → Hierarchy 𝚷 (s + 1) (∀' φ)
  | dummy_sigma {s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)}  : Hierarchy 𝚷 (s + 1) φ → Hierarchy 𝚺 (s + 1 + 1) (∀' φ)
  | dummy_pi {s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)}     : Hierarchy 𝚺 (s + 1) φ → Hierarchy 𝚷 (s + 1 + 1) (∃' φ)

def DeltaZero (φ : Semiformula L ξ n) : Prop := Hierarchy 𝚺 0 φ

attribute [simp] Hierarchy.verum Hierarchy.falsum Hierarchy.rel Hierarchy.nrel

namespace Hierarchy

@[simp] lemma and_iff {φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ s (φ ⋏ ψ) ↔ Hierarchy Γ s φ ∧ Hierarchy Γ s ψ :=
  ⟨by generalize hr : φ ⋏ ψ = r
      intro H
      induction H <;> try simp [LO.ball, LO.bex] at hr
      case and =>
        rcases hr with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
        constructor <;> assumption,
   by rintro ⟨hp, hq⟩; exact Hierarchy.and hp hq⟩

@[simp] lemma or_iff {φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ s (φ ⋎ ψ) ↔ Hierarchy Γ s φ ∧ Hierarchy Γ s ψ :=
  ⟨by generalize hr : φ ⋎ ψ = r
      intro H
      induction H <;> try simp [LO.ball, LO.bex] at hr
      case or =>
        rcases hr with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
        constructor <;> assumption,
      by rintro ⟨hp, hq⟩; exact Hierarchy.or hp hq⟩

@[simp] lemma conj_iff {φ : Fin m → Semiformula L ξ n} :
    Hierarchy Γ s (Matrix.conj φ) ↔ ∀ i, Hierarchy Γ s (φ i) := by
  induction m <;> simp[Matrix.conj, Matrix.vecTail, *]
  · exact ⟨by rintro ⟨hz, hs⟩ i; cases i using Fin.cases <;> simp[*],
           by intro h; exact ⟨h 0, fun _ => h _⟩⟩

lemma zero_eq_alt {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ 0 φ → Hierarchy Γ.alt 0 φ := by
  generalize hz : 0 = z
  rw[eq_comm] at hz
  intro h
  induction h <;> try simp at hz ⊢
  case and _ _ ihp ihq =>
    exact ⟨ihp hz, ihq hz⟩
  case or _ _ ihp ihq => exact ⟨ihp hz, ihq hz⟩
  case ball pos _ ih => exact ball pos (ih hz)
  case bex pos _ ih => exact bex pos (ih hz)

lemma pi_zero_iff_sigma_zero {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy 𝚷 0 φ ↔ Hierarchy 𝚺 0 φ := ⟨zero_eq_alt, zero_eq_alt⟩

lemma zero_iff {Γ Γ'} {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ 0 φ ↔ Hierarchy Γ' 0 φ := by rcases Γ <;> rcases Γ' <;> simp[pi_zero_iff_sigma_zero]

lemma zero_iff_delta_zero {Γ} {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ 0 φ ↔ DeltaZero φ := by
  simp[DeltaZero, pi_zero_iff_sigma_zero]; apply zero_iff

@[simp] lemma alt_zero_iff_zero {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ.alt 0 φ ↔ Hierarchy Γ 0 φ := by rcases Γ <;> simp[pi_zero_iff_sigma_zero]

lemma accum : ∀ {Γ} {s : ℕ} {φ : Semiformula L ξ n}, Hierarchy Γ s φ → ∀ Γ', Hierarchy Γ' (s + 1) φ
  | _, _, _, verum _ _ _,    _ => verum _ _ _
  | _, _, _, falsum _ _ _,   _ => falsum _ _ _
  | _, _, _, rel _ _ r v,    _ => rel _ _ r v
  | _, _, _, nrel _ _ r v,   _ => nrel _ _ r v
  | _, _, _, and hp hq,      _ => and (hp.accum _) (hq.accum _)
  | _, _, _, or hp hq,       _ => or (hp.accum _) (hq.accum _)
  | _, _, _, ball pos hp,    Γ => ball pos (hp.accum _)
  | _, _, _, bex pos hp,     Γ => bex pos (hp.accum _)
  | _, _, _, all hp,         Γ => by
    cases Γ
    · exact hp.dummy_sigma
    · exact (hp.accum 𝚷).all
  | _, _, _, ex hp,          Γ => by
    cases Γ
    · exact (hp.accum 𝚺).ex
    · exact hp.dummy_pi
  | _, _, _, sigma hp,       Γ => by
    cases Γ
    · exact ((hp.accum 𝚺).accum 𝚺).ex
    · exact (hp.accum 𝚺).dummy_pi
  | _, _, _, pi hp,          Γ => by
    cases Γ
    · exact (hp.accum 𝚷).dummy_sigma
    · exact ((hp.accum 𝚷).accum 𝚷).all
  | _, _, _, dummy_sigma hp, Γ => by
    cases Γ
    · exact (hp.accum 𝚷).dummy_sigma
    · exact ((hp.accum 𝚷).accum 𝚷).all
  | _, _, _, dummy_pi hp,    Γ => by
    cases Γ
    · exact ((hp.accum 𝚺).accum 𝚺).ex
    · exact (hp.accum 𝚺).dummy_pi

lemma strict_mono {Γ s} {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} (hp : Hierarchy Γ s φ) (Γ') {s'} (h : s < s') : Hierarchy Γ' s' φ := by
  have : ∀ d, Hierarchy Γ' (s + d + 1) φ := by
    intro d
    induction' d with s ih
    · simpa using hp.accum Γ'
    · simpa only [Nat.add_succ, add_zero] using ih.accum _
  simpa [show s + (s' - s.succ) + 1 = s' from by simpa [Nat.succ_add] using Nat.add_sub_of_le h] using this (s' - s.succ)

lemma mono {Γ} {s s' : ℕ} {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} (hp : Hierarchy Γ s φ) (h : s ≤ s') : Hierarchy Γ s' φ := by
  rcases Nat.lt_or_eq_of_le h with (lt | rfl)
  · exact hp.strict_mono Γ lt
  · assumption

lemma of_zero {b b'} {s : ℕ} {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} (hp : Hierarchy b 0 φ) : Hierarchy b' s φ := by
  rcases Nat.eq_or_lt_of_le (Nat.zero_le s) with (rfl | pos)
  · exact zero_iff.mp hp
  · exact strict_mono hp b' pos

section

variable {L : Language}

@[simp] lemma equal [L.Eq] [L.LT] {t u : Semiterm L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ s “!!t = !!u” := by
  simp[Semiformula.Operator.operator, Matrix.fun_eq_vec₂,
    Semiformula.Operator.Eq.sentence_eq]

@[simp] lemma lt [L.LT] {t u : Semiterm L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ s “!!t < !!u” := by
  simp[Semiformula.Operator.operator, Matrix.fun_eq_vec₂,
    Semiformula.Operator.Eq.sentence_eq, Semiformula.Operator.LT.sentence_eq]

@[simp] lemma le [L.Eq] [L.LT] {t u : Semiterm L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ s “!!t ≤ !!u” := by
  simp[Semiformula.Operator.operator, Matrix.fun_eq_vec₂,
    Semiformula.Operator.Eq.sentence_eq, Semiformula.Operator.LT.sentence_eq,
    Semiformula.Operator.LE.sentence_eq]

end

lemma neg {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ s φ → Hierarchy Γ.alt s (∼φ) := by
  intro h; induction h <;> try simp[*]
  case bex pos _ ih => exact ball pos ih
  case ball pos _ ih => exact bex pos ih
  case ex ih => exact all ih
  case all ih => exact ex ih
  case sigma ih => exact pi ih
  case pi ih => exact sigma ih
  case dummy_pi ih => exact dummy_sigma ih
  case dummy_sigma ih => exact dummy_pi ih

@[simp] lemma neg_iff {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ s (∼φ) ↔ Hierarchy Γ.alt s φ :=
  ⟨fun h => by simpa using neg h, fun h => by simpa using neg h⟩

@[simp] lemma imp_iff {φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ s (φ ➝ ψ) ↔ (Hierarchy Γ.alt s φ ∧ Hierarchy Γ s ψ) := by simp[Semiformula.imp_eq]

@[simp] lemma ball_iff {Γ s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)} {t : Semiterm L ξ (n + 1)} (ht : t.Positive) :
    Hierarchy Γ s (∀[“x. x < !!t”] φ) ↔ Hierarchy Γ s φ :=
  ⟨by generalize hq : (∀[“x. x < !!t”] φ) = ψ
      intro H
      induction H <;> try simp [LO.ball, LO.bex] at hq
      case ball φ t pt hp ih =>
        rcases hq with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
        assumption
      case all hp ih =>
        rcases hq with rfl
        simpa using hp
      case pi s _ _ hp ih =>
        rcases hq with rfl
        exact (show Hierarchy 𝚺 s φ from by simpa using hp).accum _
      case dummy_sigma hp _ =>
        rcases hq with rfl
        simp at hp
        exact hp.accum _,
   by intro hp; exact hp.ball ht⟩

@[simp] lemma bex_iff {Γ s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)} {t : Semiterm L ξ (n + 1)} (ht : t.Positive) :
    Hierarchy Γ s (∃[“x. x < !!t”] φ) ↔ Hierarchy Γ s φ :=
  ⟨by generalize hq : (∃[“x. x < !!t”] φ) = ψ
      intro H
      induction H <;> try simp [LO.ball, LO.bex] at hq
      case bex φ t pt hp ih =>
        rcases hq with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
        assumption
      case ex hp ih =>
        rcases hq with rfl
        simpa using hp
      case sigma s _ _ hp ih =>
        rcases hq with rfl
        exact (show Hierarchy 𝚷 s φ from by simpa using hp).accum _
      case dummy_pi hp _ =>
        rcases hq with rfl
        simp at hp
        exact hp.accum _,
   by intro hp; exact hp.bex ht⟩

@[simp] lemma ballLT_iff {Γ s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)} {t : Semiterm L ξ n} :
    Hierarchy Γ s (φ.ballLT t) ↔ Hierarchy Γ s φ := by simp [Semiformula.ballLT]

@[simp] lemma bexLT_iff {Γ s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)} {t : Semiterm L ξ n} :
    Hierarchy Γ s (φ.bexLT t) ↔ Hierarchy Γ s φ := by simp [Semiformula.bexLT]

@[simp] lemma ballLTSucc_iff [L.Zero] [L.One] [L.Add] {Γ s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)} {t : Semiterm L ξ n} :
    Hierarchy Γ s (φ.ballLTSucc t) ↔ Hierarchy Γ s φ := by simp [Semiformula.ballLTSucc]

@[simp] lemma bexLTSucc_iff [L.Zero] [L.One] [L.Add] {Γ s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)} {t : Semiterm L ξ n} :
    Hierarchy Γ s (φ.bexLTSucc t) ↔ Hierarchy Γ s φ := by simp [Semiformula.bexLTSucc]

lemma pi_of_pi_all {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)} : Hierarchy 𝚷 s (∀' φ) → Hierarchy 𝚷 s φ := by
  generalize hr : ∀' φ = r
  generalize hb : (𝚷 : Polarity) = Γ
  intro H
  cases H <;> try simp [LO.ball, LO.bex] at hr
  case ball => rcases hr with rfl; simpa
  case all => rcases hr with rfl; simpa
  case pi hp => rcases hr with rfl; exact hp.accum _
  case dummy_sigma hp => rcases hr with rfl; exact hp.accum _

@[simp] lemma all_iff {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)} : Hierarchy 𝚷 (s + 1) (∀' φ) ↔ Hierarchy 𝚷 (s + 1) φ :=
  ⟨pi_of_pi_all, all⟩

lemma sigma_of_sigma_ex {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)} : Hierarchy 𝚺 s (∃' φ) → Hierarchy 𝚺 s φ := by
  generalize hr : ∃' φ = r
  generalize hb : (𝚺 : Polarity) = Γ
  intro H
  cases H <;> try simp [LO.ball, LO.bex] at hr
  case bex => rcases hr with rfl; simpa
  case ex => rcases hr with rfl; simpa
  case sigma hp => rcases hr with rfl; exact hp.accum _
  case dummy_pi hp => rcases hr with rfl; exact hp.accum _

@[simp] lemma sigma_iff {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)} : Hierarchy 𝚺 (s + 1) (∃' φ) ↔ Hierarchy 𝚺 (s + 1) φ := by exact?

lemma strict_mono {Γ s} {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} (hp : Hierarchy Γ s φ) (Γ') {s'} (h : s < s') : Hierarchy Γ' s' φ := by
  have : ∀ d, Hierarchy Γ' (s + d + 1) φ := by
    intro d
    induction' d with s ih
    · simpa using hp.accum Γ'
    · simpa only [Nat.add_succ, add_zero] using ih.accum _
  simpa [show s + (s' - s.succ) + 1 = s' from by simpa [Nat.succ_add] using Nat.add_sub_of_le h] using this (s' - s.succ)

lemma mono {Γ} {s s' : ℕ} {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} (hp : Hierarchy Γ s φ) (h : s ≤ s') : Hierarchy Γ s' φ := by
  rcases Nat.lt_or_eq_of_le h with (lt | rfl)
  · exact hp.strict_mono Γ lt
  · assumption

lemma of_zero {b b'} {s : ℕ} {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} (hp : Hierarchy b 0 φ) : Hierarchy b' s φ := by
  rcases Nat.eq_or_lt_of_le (Nat.zero_le s) with (rfl | pos)
  · exact zero_iff.mp hp
  · exact strict_mono hp b' pos

    Semiformula.Operator.Eq.sentence_eq]

@[simp] lemma lt [L.LT] {t u : Semiterm L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ s “!!t < !!u” := by

    Semiformula.Operator.Eq.sentence_eq, Semiformula.Operator.LT.sentence_eq]

@[simp] lemma le [L.Eq] [L.LT] {t u : Semiterm L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ s “!!t ≤ !!u” := by

lemma neg {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ s φ → Hierarchy Γ.alt s (∼φ) := by
  intro h; induction h <;> try simp[*]
  case bex pos _ ih => exact ball pos ih
  case ball pos _ ih => exact bex pos ih
  case ex ih => exact all ih
  case all ih => exact ex ih
  case sigma ih => exact pi ih
  case pi ih => exact sigma ih
  case dummy_pi ih => exact dummy_sigma ih
  case dummy_sigma ih => exact dummy_pi ih

@[simp] lemma neg_iff {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ s (∼φ) ↔ Hierarchy Γ.alt s φ :=
  ⟨fun h => by simpa using neg h, fun h => by simpa using neg h⟩

@[simp] lemma imp_iff {φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ s (φ ➝ ψ) ↔ (Hierarchy Γ.alt s φ ∧ Hierarchy Γ s ψ) := by simp[Semiformula.imp_eq]

@[simp] lemma ball_iff {Γ s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)} {t : Semiterm L ξ (n + 1)} (ht : t.Positive) :
    Hierarchy Γ s (∀[“x. x < !!t”] φ) ↔ Hierarchy Γ s φ :=
  ⟨by generalize hq : (∀[“x. x < !!t”] φ) = ψ
      intro H
      induction H <;> try simp [LO.ball, LO.bex] at hq
      case ball φ t pt hp ih =>
        rcases hq with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
        assumption
      case all hp ih =>
        rcases hq with rfl
        simpa using hp
      case pi s _ _ hp ih =>
        rcases hq with rfl
        exact (show Hierarchy 𝚺 s φ from by simpa using hp).accum _
      case dummy_sigma hp _ =>
        rcases hq with rfl
        simp at hp
        exact hp.accum _,

      case bex φ t pt hp ih =>

      case ex hp ih =>

        simpa using hp
      case sigma s _ _ hp ih =>
        rcases hq with rfl
        exact (show Hierarchy 𝚷 s φ from by simpa using hp).accum _

        rcases hq with rfl
        simp at hp
        exact hp.accum _,

  generalize hr : ∀' φ = r
  generalize hb : (𝚷 : Polarity) = Γ
  intro H
  cases H <;> try simp [LO.ball, LO.bex] at hr
  case ball => rcases hr with rfl; simpa
  case all => rcases hr with rfl; simpa
  case pi hp => rcases hr with rfl; exact hp.accum _
  case dummy_sigma hp => rcases hr with rfl; exact hp.accum _

C0_dependencies.name: LO.FirstOrder.Arith.Hierarchy.and_iff
C0_dependencies.content:
@[simp] lemma and_iff {φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ s (φ ⋏ ψ) ↔ Hierarchy Γ s φ ∧ Hierarchy Γ s ψ :=
  ⟨by generalize hr : φ ⋏ ψ = r
      intro H
      induction H <;> try simp [LO.ball, LO.bex] at hr
      case and =>
        rcases hr with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
        constructor <;> assumption,
   by rintro ⟨hp, hq⟩; exact Hierarchy.and hp hq⟩

C0_dependencies.name: LO.FirstOrder.Arith.Hierarchy.conj_iff
C0_dependencies.content:
@[simp] lemma conj_iff {φ : Fin m → Semiformula L ξ n} :
    Hierarchy Γ s (Matrix.conj φ) ↔ ∀ i, Hierarchy Γ s (φ i) := by
  induction m <;> simp[Matrix.conj, Matrix.vecTail, *]
  · exact ⟨by rintro ⟨hz, hs⟩ i; cases i using Fin.cases <;> simp[*],
